choices: They finished to paint the fence before lunch.
Jiho kept asking me the same question.
He refused helping me with my homework.
I expect hearing good news from you.
Remember turning off the lights when you leave.
items.exp: keep은 동명사를 목적어로 써요. refuse to help, finish painting, expect to hear, 앞으로 할 일이므로 Remember to turn off가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: He stopped to buy some water on the way home.
Please remember to bring your lunch tomorrow.
Try pressing this button if the machine doesn't work.
Don't forget sending me the photos tonight.
I remember meeting her at the festival two years ago.
items.exp: tonight 할 일, 즉 앞으로 할 일을 잊지 말라는 뜻이므로 forget to send로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: The baby stopped to cry when his mom held him.
They decided not to go out because of the rain.
She avoided to look at me.
He practiced to kick the ball every day.
I'm planning visiting my aunt in Daegu.
items.exp: decide not to가 옳아요. plan to visit, avoid looking, practice kicking, 우는 것을 멈춘 것이므로 stopped crying이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: I'll try to finish the work by five.
My sister loves baking bread on weekends.
He chose to study art in Italy.
They agreed sharing the cost of the trip.
items.exp: agree는 to부정사를 목적어로 쓰므로 agreed to share로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) My brother enjoys playing computer games.
(b) I hope to see you again soon.
(c) She suggested going to the beach.
(d) We need finishing this by tomorrow.
(e) He continued working until midnight.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. enjoy+동명사예요. (b) 옳음. hope+to부정사예요. (c) 옳음. suggest+동명사예요. (d) 틀림: need+to부정사이므로 to finish예요. (e) 옳음. continue는 동명사·to부정사 모두 가능해요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) I will never forget seeing the ocean for the first time.
(b) Sorry, I forgot calling you yesterday.
(c) He tried to lift the box, but it was too heavy.
(d) She hates waiting in line.
(e) They put off making a decision.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거의 경험이므로 forget+동명사예요. (b) 틀림: 전화하는 것을 잊어서 못 한 것이므로 forgot to call이에요. (c) 옳음. '~하려고 애쓰다'는 try+to부정사예요. (d) 옳음. hate는 동명사·to부정사 모두 가능해요. (e) 옳음. put off+동명사예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) He promised calling me every day.
(b) Stop talking and listen to me.
(c) I learned riding a horse last summer.
(d) Would you mind to close the window?
(e) My mom wants me to keep practicing the piano.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: promise+to부정사이므로 to call이에요. (b) 옳음. 말하는 것을 멈추라는 뜻이라 stop+동명사예요. (c) 틀림: learn+to부정사이므로 to ride예요. (d) 틀림: mind+동명사이므로 closing이에요. (e) 옳음. want+목적어+to부정사, keep+동명사예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) She gave up trying to win the game.
(b) I like reading mystery novels.
(c) He refused answering the question.
(d) They kept walking in the rain.
(e) We hope finding our lost dog soon.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. give up+동명사예요. (b) 옳음. like는 동명사·to부정사 모두 가능해요. (c) 틀림: refuse+to부정사이므로 to answer예요. (d) 옳음. keep+동명사예요. (e) 틀림: hope+to부정사이므로 to find예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Remember to call your grandma this evening.
(b) He stopped to take a picture of the sunset.
(c) She finished writing the report an hour ago.
(d) I remember to see this movie when I was a kid.
(e) Mina decided joining the drama club.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 앞으로 할 일이므로 remember+to부정사예요. (b) 옳음. 사진을 찍기 위해 멈춘 것이에요. (c) 옳음. finish+동명사예요. (d) 틀림: 과거에 한 일이므로 remember seeing이에요. (e) 틀림: decide+to부정사이므로 to join이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I'm considering learning Japanese.
(b) We expect to arrive by noon.
(c) The kids began singing loudly.
(d) She doesn't mind to share her room.
(e) Don't forget to water the plants while I'm away.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. consider+동명사예요. (b) 옳음. expect+to부정사예요. (c) 옳음. begin은 동명사·to부정사 모두 가능해요. (d) 틀림: mind+동명사이므로 sharing이에요. (e) 옳음. 앞으로 할 일이므로 forget+to부정사예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I remember (A) ___ this song at the concert last year.
• Remember (B) ___ your homework tomorrow.
items.exp: (A) 작년에 이미 한 일을 기억하므로 remember+동명사, (B) 내일 할 일을 기억하라는 것이므로 remember+to부정사예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• He felt sleepy while driving, so he stopped (A) ___ a short rest.
• Coffee keeps my dad awake, so he wants to stop (B) ___ it at night.
items.exp: (A) 쉬기 위해 멈춘 것이므로 stop+to부정사(목적), (B) 커피 마시는 것을 그만두려는 것이므로 stop+동명사예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• Jenny is learning (A) ___ the guitar these days.
• Would you mind (B) ___ me a hand?
• He pretended (C) ___ asleep.
items.exp: learn과 pretend는 to부정사, mind는 동명사를 목적어로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 작년에 그녀를 공항에서 본 것을 기억한다.
items.s: I ___ at the airport last year.
items.exp: 작년에 이미 한 일을 기억하는 것이므로 remember+동명사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 지난주에 매일 운동하기로 결심했다.
items.s: Last week, he ___ every day.
items.exp: 지난주이므로 과거 decided, decide는 to부정사를 목적어로 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The doctor told me to avoid [to eat] too much salt. → ___
items.exp: avoid는 동명사만 목적어로 쓰므로 eating이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 시험 삼아 창문을 열어 보았지만, 방은 여전히 더웠다.
items.s: She ___ the window, but the room was still hot.
items.exp: '시험 삼아 ~해 보다'는 try+동명사이고, 과거이므로 tried opening이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 아이들은 계속 질문을 했고, 선생님은 친절하게 대답해 주셨다.
items.s: The kids ___ questions, and the teacher kindly answered them.
items.exp: keep은 동명사를 목적어로 쓰고, 과거 이야기이므로 kept asking이에요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Jun doesn't play online games anymore.
items.s: Jun has ___ online games.
items.exp: '더 이상 하지 않는다' = '하는 것을 그만두었다'이므로 stop+동명사이고, has 뒤에는 과거분사 stopped가 와요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The accident happened near my school.
My phone was disappeared from my desk.
This song is loved by many teenagers.
The cookies were baked by my sister.
The window was broken by a baseball.
items.exp: disappear는 목적어를 쓰지 않는 자동사라서 수동태로 쓸 수 없어요. My phone disappeared로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: This bag is belonged to Minji.
A strange man was appeared at the door.
The museum visits by thousands of people every year.
The flowers in the vase was picked by my mom.
Many trees were planted by the students last spring.
items.exp: 나무가 심어진 것이고 과거·복수이므로 were planted가 맞아요. is visited, belongs, appeared, 주어 The flowers에 맞춘 were picked가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: The robot was made by a group of students.
He resembles his father a lot.
The window cleaned by Tom every Saturday.
The bus arrived ten minutes late.
items.exp: 창문은 청소되는 대상이므로 be동사가 필요해요. The window is cleaned by Tom이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: The dog was died last year.
The game was watched by millions of people around the world.
Many people are loved this movie.
The prize was gave to the winner.
The cake was made by she.
items.exp: 경기가 시청된 것이므로 was watched가 옳아요. died, by her, love, was given이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: Dinner is cooked by my dad on Sundays.
The soccer game was canceled because of the rain.
The baby was born in March.
These books are read by many children last year.
items.exp: last year가 있으므로 과거 수동태 were read로 써야 해요. read의 과거분사는 형태가 같아서 be동사 시제로 판단해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The car was washed by my dad.
(b) The cat is fed by my brother every morning.
(c) Something strange was happened last night.
(d) My dog was hit by a bike yesterday.
(e) The students in my class is taught by Ms. Lee.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 차는 세차되는 대상이에요. (b) 옳음. feed의 과거분사 fed, 현재 수동태예요. (c) 틀림: happen은 자동사라 happened예요. (d) 옳음. hit의 과거분사는 hit이에요. (e) 틀림: 주어 The students가 복수이므로 are예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) The tickets were sold out in an hour.
(b) She is resembled by her daughter.
(c) These shoes are made in Italy.
(d) The thief was caught by the police.
(e) My keys disappeared this morning.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 표가 팔린 것이므로 수동태예요. (b) 틀림: resemble은 수동태로 쓰지 않아요. Her daughter resembles her.예요. (c) 옳음. 신발은 만들어지는 대상이에요. (d) 옳음. catch의 과거분사 caught예요. (e) 옳음. disappear는 자동사라 능동태예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The house is belonged to my aunt.
(b) The letter was sent by him last week.
(c) A lot of rain was fallen yesterday.
(d) The vase was broke by the cat.
(e) Pizza is loved by kids all over the world.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: belong은 수동태로 쓰지 않으므로 belongs예요. (b) 옳음. by 뒤 목적격 him이에요. (c) 틀림: fall은 자동사라 fell이에요. (d) 틀림: 과거분사 broken이에요. (e) 옳음. 단수 주어+is loved예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (e) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The windows were opened by the teacher.
(b) English is spoken in many countries.
(c) My bike was stolen last night.
(d) The plane was arrived at 9 p.m.
(e) The festival is held every October.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 복수 주어+were opened예요. (b) 옳음. by 행위자를 생략한 수동태예요. (c) 옳음. steal의 과거분사 stolen이에요. (d) 틀림: arrive는 자동사라 arrived예요. (e) 옳음. hold의 과거분사 held예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The cake was cut into eight pieces.
(b) A new bike is had by my brother.
(c) The picture was drawn by my little sister.
(d) The song was sung by them at the festival.
(e) The students was praised by the principal.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. cut의 과거분사는 cut이에요. (b) 틀림: 소유의 have는 수동태로 쓰지 않아요. (c) 옳음. draw의 과거분사 drawn이에요. (d) 옳음. sing의 과거분사 sung, by 뒤 목적격 them이에요. (e) 틀림: 복수 주어이므로 were예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The cookies were eaten by the kids.
(b) The water in the bottles were drunk by the hikers.
(c) The phone rang, but nobody answered it.
(d) The rice is cooked by my mom every night.
(e) The class was began at nine.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. eat의 과거분사 eaten이에요. (b) 틀림: 주어는 셀 수 없는 The water이므로 was예요. (c) 옳음. ring은 자동사, answer는 능동태로 맞아요. (d) 옳음. 단수 주어+is cooked예요. (e) 틀림: was 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하는데 began은 과거형이에요. 수업이 시작된 것은 began으로 써요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The bridge (A) ___ in 2015.
• Many accidents (B) ___ on this road every year.
items.exp: (A) 다리는 지어진 대상이고 2015년이므로 was built, (B) happen은 자동사라 수동태가 안 되고 복수 주어이므로 happen이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• This old watch (A) ___ to my grandfather.
• The windows (B) ___ by Jake yesterday.
items.exp: (A) belong은 수동태로 쓰지 않으므로 belonged, (B) 창문은 깨진 대상이고 복수·과거이므로 were broken이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• This poem (A) ___ by a ten-year-old girl.
• The sun (B) ___ behind the clouds.
• Her sister (C) ___ her mother very much.
items.exp: (A) 시는 쓰인 대상이라 was written, (B) disappear는 자동사라 disappeared, (C) resemble은 수동태로 쓰지 않아 resembles예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 사진은 지난여름 우리 아빠에 의해 찍혔다.
items.s: This picture ___ last summer.
items.exp: 사진은 '찍힌' 대상이고 과거이므로 was taken, 행위자는 by my dad예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Many students use this app.
items.s: This app ___.
items.exp: 목적어 this app을 주어로 하고, 현재시제·단수이므로 is used, 행위자는 by many students예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The kids broke the vase this morning.
items.s: The vase ___ this morning.
items.exp: 과거시제 broke는 was broken으로, 주어 The kids는 by the kids로 바꿔요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The accident [was happened] on a rainy night. → ___
items.exp: happen은 자동사라서 수동태로 쓸 수 없어요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 상자들은 매주 월요일 트럭으로 배달된다.
items.s: The boxes ___ by truck every Monday.
items.exp: 상자는 배달되는 대상이고, 복수 주어·현재(every Monday)이므로 are delivered예요.

items.q: 문맥에 맞게 주어진 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 가게의 주인은 3년 전에 죽었고, 지금은 그의 아들이 가게를 운영한다.
items.s: The owner of the store died three years ago, and now the store ___ his son.
items.exp: 가게는 운영되는 대상이고 now가 있으니 현재 수동태 is run이에요. run의 과거분사는 run이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The concert will be held next Friday.
The books weren't returned to the library.
Was this email sent by Mr. Kim?
items.exp: 소포는 배달되는 대상이므로 미래 수동태 will be delivered로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Will the results be announced tomorrow?
Did the door locked by Mom?
The game wasn't be played because of the rain.
The plan will is changed soon.
items.exp: 미래 수동태 의문문 「Will+주어+be+과거분사」가 옳아요. Was the door locked, wasn't played, were these pictures, will be changed가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: The cookies were not eaten by the children.
The windows will be cleaned this afternoon.
Is English taught at your school?
items.exp: 자전거는 고쳐지는 대상이므로 수동태 부정문 「be동사+not+과거분사」를 써서 wasn't fixed로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: What time the meeting will be held?
The trash will be take out by Dad.
Does this car made in Korea?
Why wasn't the store opened yesterday?
These shirts were not wash before.
items.exp: 의문사+wasn't+주어+과거분사 어순이 옳아요. will the meeting be held, were not washed, Is this car made, will be taken out이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: The winners will be chose next Monday.
What language is spoken in Brazil?
The new school will be built near the park.
Was the money found on the street?
items.exp: will be 뒤에는 과거분사가 와야 하므로 chose(과거형) → chosen으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The party will be held at my house.
(b) Was the letter written in English?
(c) The bridge didn't built last year.
(d) Where were the shoes made?
(e) The tests will be check by Friday.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 미래 수동태예요. (b) 옳음. 과거 수동태 의문문이에요. (c) 틀림: 수동태 부정문이므로 wasn't built예요. (d) 옳음. 의문사+were+주어+과거분사예요. (e) 틀림: 과거분사 checked예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) The movie wasn't liked by many people.
(b) Will the room be cleaned tomorrow?
(c) When was the photo taken?
(d) The song isn't sang by children anymore.
(e) Were the cookies baked by your grandma?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 과거 수동태 부정문이에요. (b) 옳음. 미래 수동태 의문문이에요. (c) 옳음. 의문사+was+주어+과거분사예요. (d) 틀림: 과거분사 sung이에요. (e) 옳음. 복수 주어+Were예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The news will be reported on TV tonight.
(b) How were the cookies made?
(c) Was the window broke by the ball?
(d) The game will not be played tomorrow.
(e) Is this bag sold online?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 미래 수동태예요. (b) 옳음. 의문사+were+주어+과거분사예요. (c) 틀림: 과거분사 broken이에요. (d) 옳음. 미래 수동태 부정문 will not be p.p.예요. (e) 옳음. 현재 수동태 의문문이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The meeting won't be held this week.
(b) Were these flowers planted by you?
(c) What was the baby named?
(d) The bike will be fix by tomorrow.
(e) Did the window opened by the wind?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. won't be+과거분사예요. (b) 옳음. 복수 주어+Were+과거분사예요. (c) 옳음. 의문사+was+주어+과거분사예요. (d) 틀림: 과거분사 fixed예요. (e) 틀림: 수동태 의문문은 Was the window opened예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The letter will be sent next week.
(b) Where was your car parked?
(c) The homework was not finish on time.
(d) Is the store closed on Sundays?
(e) When will be the new library opened?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 미래 수동태예요. (b) 옳음. 의문사+was+주어+과거분사예요. (c) 틀림: 과거분사 finished예요. (d) 옳음. 현재 수동태 의문문이에요. (e) 틀림: 「의문사+will+주어+be+과거분사」이므로 When will the new library be opened예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 능동태 문장을 수동태로 바르게 바꾼 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Mom will make the cake. → The cake will be made by Mom.
(b) Did he fix the computer? → Was the computer fixed by him?
(c) They didn't invite me. → I didn't invited by them.
(d) Jun cleans the room. → The room was cleaned by Jun.
(e) Will they hold the event? → Will the event held by them?
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 미래 수동태로 바르게 바꿨어요. (b) 옳음. 과거 의문문은 Was+주어+과거분사예요. (c) 틀림: I wasn't invited by them.이에요. (d) 틀림: 현재시제이므로 is cleaned예요. (e) 틀림: Will the event be held by them?이에요. 따라서 알맞은 것은 (a), (b)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• (A) ___ the windows cleaned yesterday?
• The results (B) ___ next week.
items.exp: (A) 수동태 의문문이고 the windows가 복수이므로 Were, (B) 결과는 발표되는 대상이고 미래이므로 will be announced예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• This room (A) ___ by students. It's only for teachers.
• The old tree (B) ___ down last week.
items.exp: (A) 방은 사용되는 대상이므로 수동태 부정 isn't used, (B) 나무는 베어진 대상이고 cut의 과거분사는 cut이므로 was cut이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• (A) ___ this picture painted by your brother?
• The door (B) ___ locked last night, so the thief got in easily.
• The concert (C) ___ held next month.
items.exp: (A) 수동태 의문문은 be동사로 시작하므로 Was, (B) 수동태 부정은 wasn't, (C) next month이므로 will be held예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 다리는 내년에 완성될 것이다.
items.s: The bridge ___ next year.
items.exp: 다리는 완성되는 대상이고 next year이므로 미래 수동태 will be completed예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Did your brother paint this picture?
items.s: ___ by your brother?
items.exp: 과거 의문문 Did ~ paint?는 수동태로 Was+주어+과거분사?가 돼요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: They will not change the rules.
items.s: The rules ___.
items.exp: 미래 수동태 부정문은 will not be+과거분사예요. 행위자 they는 일반인이라 생략했어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: When [was] these old coins found? → ___
items.exp: 주어 these old coins가 복수이므로 were예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 탑은 언제 지어졌니?
items.exp: 의문사가 있는 수동태 의문문은 「의문사+be동사+주어+과거분사」이고 과거이므로 When was the tower built예요.

items.q: 문맥에 맞게 주어진 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 편지는 어제 보내지지 않았다. 그것은 내일 보내질 것이다.
items.s: The letter was not sent yesterday. It ___ tomorrow.
items.exp: 편지는 보내지는 대상이고 tomorrow이므로 미래 수동태 will be sent예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The bottle is filled with orange juice.
The work must be finished by Friday.
This city is known for its delicious food.
My parents were worried about my grades.
items.exp: 조동사가 있는 수동태는 「조동사+be+과거분사」이므로 can be solved로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The park was covered of fallen leaves.
Can this song be play on the piano?
Jiwon is interested about Korean history.
Kids should be not left alone at home.
The rules must be followed by all students.
items.exp: 「must+be+과거분사」가 옳아요. should not be left, interested in, covered with, be played가 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: The museum can be visited for free on Sundays.
He is known as the best cook in our town.
I'm tired of eating the same food every day.
We were satisfied with the hotel service.
The singer's name is known for everyone in Korea.
items.exp: '~에게 알려져 있다'는 be known to이므로 known to everyone으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: The meeting may be cancel because of the snow.
This medicine must not taken with milk.
Everyone was surprised for the news.
Can these seats be used by anyone?
Should the old chairs throw away?
items.exp: 조동사 수동태 의문문 「조동사+주어+be+과거분사」가 옳아요. be canceled, be thrown away, surprised at, must not be taken이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법에 맞지 않는 것은?
choices: The cookies can be keep in the jar for a week.
The yard was covered with snow this morning.
This machine should be checked once a month.
The new rules will be explained tomorrow.
Are you satisfied with your new phone?
items.exp: 조동사 수동태는 be 뒤에 과거분사가 와야 하므로 keep → kept로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The box should be opened carefully.
(b) The street is filled with people on weekends.
(c) My sister is interested in taking photos.
(d) This book will be read by many people.
(e) He is known as his kindness.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. should be+과거분사예요. (b) 옳음. be filled with예요. (c) 옳음. be interested in+동명사예요. (d) 옳음. will be+과거분사 read예요. (e) 틀림: 이유·특징은 be known for이므로 for his kindness예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) The homework must be done by tomorrow.
(b) This bag can be carried by a child.
(c) The table was covered with a white cloth.
(d) The plan won't be changed.
(e) My dad is satisfied of his new car.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. must be+과거분사 done이에요. (b) 옳음. can be+과거분사예요. (c) 옳음. be covered with예요. (d) 옳음. won't be+과거분사예요. (e) 틀림: be satisfied with예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (e) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The trash should take out every night.
(b) Are you interested in science?
(c) The rooms must cleaned before guests arrive.
(d) This town is known for its beautiful beaches.
(e) This cake can't eat now.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 쓰레기는 내놓아지는 대상이므로 should be taken out이에요. (b) 옳음. be interested in이에요. (c) 틀림: must be cleaned예요. (d) 옳음. 특징은 be known for예요. (e) 틀림: 케이크는 먹히는 대상이므로 can't be eaten이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The window must not be opened during the test.
(b) He is known to many people as a great painter.
(c) We were surprised at the news.
(d) The work can be finish in an hour.
(e) The glass was filled of milk.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. must not be+과거분사예요. (b) 옳음. known to(~에게), as(~로서) 모두 맞아요. (c) 옳음. be surprised at이에요. (d) 틀림: 과거분사 finished예요. (e) 틀림: be filled with예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The flowers should be watered every day.
(b) I'm worried about the test tomorrow.
(c) Must this form be written in English?
(d) The singer is known as her beautiful voice.
(e) The dog can be not left alone.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. should be+과거분사예요. (b) 옳음. be worried about이에요. (c) 옳음. 조동사+주어+be+과거분사 의문문이에요. (d) 틀림: 이유·특징은 be known for예요. (e) 틀림: 조동사 수동태의 부정은 can not(cannot) be left예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This song will be loved by teens.
(b) The cup is filled with hot tea.
(c) The rules should be not broken.
(d) Your seat belt must be worn at all times.
(e) Jenny was pleased with her test score.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. will be+과거분사예요. (b) 옳음. be filled with예요. (c) 틀림: should not be broken이에요. (d) 옳음. wear의 과거분사 worn이에요. (e) 옳음. be pleased with예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The town is known (A) ___ its old temples.
• He is known (B) ___ a great teacher.
• Her name is known (C) ___ every student.
items.exp: 특징·이유는 be known for, 자격·신분은 be known as, '~에게 알려지다'는 be known to예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• This movie must (A) ___ by children under 12.
• Can these old books (B) ___?
items.exp: (A) 조동사 수동태의 부정은 「조동사+not+be+과거분사」, (B) 의문문은 「조동사+주어+be+과거분사」예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• The basket was filled (A) ___ fresh apples.
• Many students are interested (B) ___ the new club.
• We were worried (C) ___ the weather.
items.exp: be filled with, be interested in, be worried about이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 문제는 오늘 밤까지 해결되어야 한다.
items.s: This problem ___ by tonight.
items.exp: '~되어야 한다'는 조동사 수동태 must be+과거분사예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: You should not leave the windows open.
items.s: The windows ___ open.
items.exp: 조동사 수동태의 부정은 should not be+과거분사이고, leave의 과거분사는 left예요.

items.q: 주어진 문장과 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: People will forget the story soon.
items.s: The story ___ soon.
items.exp: 미래 수동태 will be+과거분사이고, forget의 과거분사는 forgotten이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My uncle is known [for] the best baker in town. → ___
items.exp: 삼촌 = 최고의 제빵사이므로 자격·신분을 나타내는 be known as예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 우리 반 모두가 그 소식에 놀랐다.
items.s: Everyone in my class ___ the news.
items.exp: Everyone은 단수 취급하므로 was, '~에 놀라다'는 be surprised at이에요.

items.q: 문맥에 맞게 주어진 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 상자들은 조심해서 옮겨져야 한다.
items.s: The boxes ___ carefully.
items.exp: 상자는 옮겨지는 대상이므로 조동사 수동태 should be carried예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I bought a book written in simple English.
Be careful with the broken glass.
The boy playing the drums is my cousin.
She kept me waiting for an hour.
The bag stealing from the store was found yesterday.
items.exp: 가방은 '도난당한' 대상이므로 수동의 의미인 과거분사 stolen으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: There are many people wait for the bus.
The man sitting next to me was reading a newspaper.
Do you know the girl wore a yellow dress?
He showed me a photo taking in Jeju.
The language speaking in Brazil is Portuguese.
items.exp: 남자가 '앉아 있는' 것이므로 sitting이 옳아요. wearing, spoken, waiting, taken이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: He sat on the bench reading a book.
The students invited to the party were happy.
The window broken by the ball need to be fixed.
There is a sleeping cat on the sofa.
I heard someone knocking on the door.
items.exp: broken은 바르게 쓰였지만 문장의 주어는 The window(단수)이므로 need → needs로 고쳐야 해요. 분사구 속 the ball에 속지 마세요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Who is the boy wear a red cap?
We heard the birds singing in the morning.
This is the picture painting by my aunt.
I saw a boy climbed the tree.
Most of the cars making in this factory are sold abroad.
items.exp: 새들이 '노래하고 있는' 것이므로 singing이 옳아요. climbing, painted, wearing, made가 되어야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The woman talking on the phone is my aunt.
(b) I want to buy a used bike.
(c) This is a toy made of wood.
(d) Look at the baby smiled at us.
(e) He left the door locked.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 여자가 '통화하고 있는' 것이에요. (b) 옳음. '사용된' 자전거, 즉 중고 자전거예요. (c) 옳음. '만들어진' 장난감이에요. (d) 틀림: 아기가 '웃고 있는' 것이므로 smiling이에요. (e) 옳음. 문이 '잠긴' 상태이므로 locked예요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
(a) There is a boy called Tom in my class.
(b) We saw a fish jumping out of the water.
(c) The cake bought for the party was delicious.
(d) The dog sleeping under the tree is mine.
(e) I heard my name calling.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. Tom이라고 '불리는' 소년이에요. (b) 옳음. 물고기가 '뛰어오르는' 것이에요. (c) 옳음. 케이크는 '구입된' 대상이에요. (d) 옳음. 개가 '자고 있는' 것이에요. (e) 틀림: 이름은 '불리는' 대상이므로 called예요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (e) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것의 개수는?
(a) The singer standing on the stage looks nervous.
(b) The house built by my grandfather is very old.
(c) Look at the boy ran in the park.
(d) We visited a temple building 500 years ago.
(e) The story writing by a student won the prize.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 가수가 '서 있는' 것이고, 주어가 단수라 looks예요. (b) 옳음. 집은 '지어진' 대상이에요. (c) 틀림: 소년이 '달리고 있는' 것이므로 running이에요. (d) 틀림: 절은 '지어진' 대상이므로 built예요. (e) 틀림: 이야기는 '쓰인' 대상이므로 written이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The smiling girl waved at me.
(b) I received a card sent from Canada.
(c) The bus carrying the students arrived late.
(d) She got a gift wrapping in red paper.
(e) He kept the music playing loudly.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. '웃고 있는' 소녀예요. (b) 옳음. 카드는 '보내진' 대상이에요. (c) 옳음. 버스가 학생들을 '태우고 있는' 것이에요. (d) 틀림: 선물은 '포장된' 대상이므로 wrapped예요. (e) 옳음. 음악이 '연주되고 있는(흘러나오는)' 상태라 playing이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Who is the man waving his hand?
(b) The game played last night was exciting.
(c) I saw the old lady crossed the street.
(d) Don't touch the boiling water.
(e) There were many students wore glasses.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 남자가 '손을 흔들고 있는' 것이에요. (b) 옳음. 경기는 '치러진' 대상이에요. (c) 틀림: 할머니가 '건너고 있는' 것이므로 crossing(또는 cross)이에요. (d) 옳음. '끓고 있는' 물이에요. (e) 틀림: 학생들을 꾸며야 하므로 wearing이에요. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The kids sat on the floor watching TV.
(b) My phone was found broken on the road.
(c) I felt the ground shook.
(d) The letter was writing in English.
(e) The boy came running to me.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. 'TV를 보면서' 앉아 있던 것이에요. (b) 옳음. 휴대폰이 '부서진' 상태였어요. (c) 틀림: 땅이 '흔들리는' 것이므로 shaking(또는 shake)이에요. (d) 틀림: 편지는 '쓰인' 것이므로 was written이에요. (e) 옳음. '달려서' 온 것이에요. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• Please don't touch the (A) ___ glass. You'll cut yourself.
• The man (B) ___ a bike over there is my uncle.
items.exp: (A) 유리는 '깨진' 상태이므로 broken, (B) 남자가 자전거를 '타고 있는' 것이므로 riding이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I heard my name (A) ___ by the teacher.
• She watched the kids (B) ___ in the pool.
items.exp: (A) 이름은 '불리는' 대상이므로 called, (B) 아이들이 '수영하고 있는' 것이므로 swimming이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> The girl [dancing] on the stage is my sister.
choices: The man [fixing] my car is very kind.
items.exp: <보기>의 dancing은 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 현재분사예요. fixing도 the man을 꾸미는 현재분사이고, 나머지는 주어, 목적어, 용도, 보어로 쓰인 동명사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> We need a new [washing] machine.
choices: Put the milk in the [shopping] cart.
I put my [sleeping] bag in the car.
Look at the [running] horse in the field.
items.exp: <보기>의 washing machine은 '세탁하기 위한 기계'로 용도를 나타내는 동명사예요. running horse는 '달리고 있는 말'로 현재분사이고, 나머지는 모두 용도의 동명사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 벤치에 앉아 있는 소녀는 내 친구이다.
items.s: The girl ___ is my friend.
items.exp: 소녀가 '앉아 있는' 것이므로 현재분사 sitting이고, 다른 어구와 함께 쓰여 명사 뒤에서 꾸며요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이것은 100년 전에 지어진 집이다.
items.s: This is a house ___.
items.exp: 집은 '지어진' 대상이므로 과거분사 built가 뒤에서 꾸며요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I heard someone [called] my name from behind. → ___
items.exp: 누군가가 내 이름을 '부르는' 능동의 관계이므로 calling(또는 동사원형 call)이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 그 문이 잠겨 있는 것을 발견했다.
items.exp: 문이 '잠긴' 상태이므로 목적격보어로 과거분사 locked를 쓰고, 과거이므로 found예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 콘서트에 초대된 학생들은 매우 신이 났다.
items.s: The students ___ the concert were very excited.
items.exp: 학생들은 '초대된' 대상이므로 과거분사 invited, '~에 초대되다'이므로 to를 써요.

items.q: 문맥에 맞게 주어진 동사를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 영어로 쓰인 그 책은 많은 학생들에게 읽힌다.
items.s: The book ___ by many students.
items.exp: 책은 '쓰인' 대상이라 과거분사 written in English가 뒤에서 꾸며요. 주어 The book은 '읽히는' 대상이고 단수·현재이므로 is read예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The players were disappointing with the result of the final game.
The story about the lost dog was so touching that many readers cried.
Most of the students looked confused after the teacher's long explanation.
The number of people interested in the event has grown.
Walking in the rain without an umbrella was not pleasant.
items.exp: 선수들이 실망을 '느낀' 것이므로 disappointing이 아니라 disappointed를 써야 해요. The number of ~는 단수 취급이라 has가 맞고, 동명사 주어 Walking ~도 단수라 was가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I was surprising that nobody remembered my birthday.
Every child in the photos look excited.
The ending of the movie was so shocked that we couldn't say a word.
My grandparents were very pleasing with the flowers we sent.
The tired hikers sitting under the tree were drinking water.
items.exp: 등산객들이 피곤함을 느낀 것이므로 tired, 나무 아래 '앉아 있는' 것이므로 sitting이 맞아요. 나머지는 surprised, looks(Every child는 단수), shocking, pleased로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: It was an amazing experience to see whales so close.
The kids felt bored because the line was too long.
The news that the school would close for a week were surprising to us.
Watching scary movies alone makes me frightened.
She told us an interesting story about her trip to the island.
items.exp: 주어의 핵심은 The news(셀 수 없는 명사, 단수)이므로 were가 아니라 was를 써야 해요. surprising은 소식이 놀라움을 주는 쪽이라 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: The math test was so confused that half the class failed.
Don't be frightening. The dog won't bite you.
My little brother was so exciting that he couldn't sleep the night before the trip.
We were amazing at how fast the robot cleaned the room.
Being praised by the coach made the players satisfied.
items.exp: 선수들이 만족을 '느끼게 된' 것이므로 목적격보어 satisfied가 맞아요. 나머지는 confusing, frightened, excited, amazed로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The children were excited by the magic show.
(b) His jokes are always so bored that nobody laughs.
(c) I found the instructions really confusing.
(d) Mina looked worried when she couldn't find her phone.
(e) The tiring workers went home early.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 아이들이 신이 난 것이라 excited. (b) 틀림: 농담이 지루하게 만드는 쪽이므로 boring. (c) 옳음: 설명서가 혼란스럽게 만드는 쪽이라 목적격보어 confusing. (d) 옳음: 미나가 걱정을 느낀 것이라 worried. (e) 틀림: 일꾼들이 피곤함을 느낀 것이므로 tired. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The players were disappointing at the referee's decision.
(b) It is surprised that he finished the work alone.
(c) The festival was full of excited visitors.
(d) We had an embarrassed moment when the music stopped suddenly.
(e) The boy kept me waiting for an hour, so I got annoying.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 선수들이 실망을 느낀 것이므로 disappointed. (b) 틀림: 가주어 It(그 사실)이 놀라움을 주는 쪽이므로 surprising. (c) 옳음: 방문객들이 신이 난 것이라 excited. (d) 틀림: 순간(moment)이 당황스럽게 만드는 쪽이므로 embarrassing. (e) 틀림: 내가 짜증을 느낀 것이므로 annoyed. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I was shocked to hear that the old bridge fell down.
(b) Have you ever been interesting in learning a foreign language?
(c) The movie was not as interested as I expected.
(d) The tired runner finally reached the finish line.
(e) Losing the game twice in a row was very disappointed for us.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 내가 충격을 받은 것이라 shocked. (b) 틀림: 사람이 관심을 느끼는 것이므로 be interested in. (c) 틀림: 영화가 흥미를 주는 쪽이므로 interesting. (d) 옳음: 주자가 피곤함을 느낀 것이라 tired. (e) 틀림: 경기에 진 일이 실망을 주는 쪽이므로 disappointing. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) My parents were satisfied with my report card.
(b) The final scene of the play was really moved.
(c) The lost child looked frightened and began to cry.
(d) Reading comic books are relaxing for me.
(e) The visitors were bored, so some of them left early.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부모님이 만족을 느낀 것이라 satisfied. (b) 틀림: 장면이 감동을 주는 쪽이므로 moving. (c) 옳음: 아이가 겁을 먹은 것이라 frightened. (d) 틀림: 동명사 주어는 단수 취급하므로 is. (e) 옳음: 방문객들이 지루함을 느낀 것이라 bored. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He gave me a very confusing answer.
(b) I am exciting about our school trip next week.
(c) The noise from the street was annoying all night.
(d) She felt embarrassing when she fell on the stage.
(e) The broken window made the room cold.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 대답이 혼란스럽게 만드는 쪽이라 confusing. (b) 틀림: 내가 신이 난 것이므로 excited. (c) 옳음: 소음이 짜증 나게 하는 쪽이라 annoying. (d) 틀림: 그녀가 당황함을 느낀 것이므로 embarrassed. (e) 옳음: 창문이 '깨진' 것이라 과거분사 broken. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Everyone was amazed at the size of the cake.
(b) Look at the leaves falling from the trees.
(c) I didn't know the movie would be so terrified.
(d) The players were pleased with their surprising win.
(e) Tom seemed interesting in my plan, but he didn't join us.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 모두가 놀라움을 느낀 것이라 amazed. (b) 옳음: 나뭇잎이 '떨어지고 있는' 것이라 현재분사 falling. (c) 틀림: 영화가 무섭게 만드는 쪽이므로 terrifying. (d) 옳음: 선수들은 기쁨을 느낀 것이라 pleased, 승리는 놀라움을 주는 것이라 surprising. (e) 틀림: Tom이 관심을 느낀 것이므로 interested. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The trip was long and (A)(tiring / tired), so we were all (B)(tiring / tired) when we got home. But the (C)(amazing / amazed) view from the hotel made us happy.
items.exp: 여행은 피곤하게 만드는 쪽이라 tiring, 우리는 피곤함을 느낀 쪽이라 tired, 경치는 놀라움을 주는 쪽이라 amazing이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
The results of the survey that the teachers did (A)(was / were) (B)(surprising / surprised), and the students were also (C)(shocking / shocked).
items.exp: 주어의 핵심이 The results(복수)라 were, 결과가 놀라움을 주는 쪽이라 surprising, 학생들은 충격을 받은 쪽이라 shocked예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> The baby [sleeping] in the bed is my cousin.
choices: My dad bought a new [sleeping] bag for camping.
items.exp: <보기>의 sleeping은 명사 baby를 꾸미는 현재분사(~하고 있는)예요. calling도 someone의 동작을 나타내는 현재분사이고, 나머지는 용도·보어·주어·전치사의 목적어로 쓰인 동명사예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> We need a new [washing] machine.
choices: I left my [running] shoes at school.
The girl [washing] the dishes is my sister.
He was [running] when I saw him.
items.exp: <보기>의 washing은 '세탁용'이라는 용도를 나타내는 동명사예요. running shoes(달리기용 신발)의 running도 용도의 동명사이고, 나머지는 '~하고 있는'의 뜻인 현재분사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 결과에 실망한 선수들은 고개를 숙였다.
items.s: ___ bowed their heads.
a: The players disappointed with the result
items.exp: 선수들이 실망을 '느낀' 것이므로 과거분사 disappointed를 쓰고, 뒤에 with the result가 붙어 길어졌으니 명사 뒤에서 꾸며요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소식은 우리 모두에게 충격적이었고, 우리는 오랫동안 한마디도 할 수 없었다.
items.s: The news ___ all of us, and we couldn't say a word for a long time.
items.exp: 소식이 충격을 '주는' 쪽이므로 현재분사 shocking을 쓰고, 과거의 일이라 was를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The lecture was long, and many students looked [boring]. → ___
items.exp: 학생들이 지루함을 '느낀' 것이므로 감각동사 look 뒤에 과거분사 bored를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The stories in this book [is very touched], so I recommend it. → ___
items.exp: 주어의 핵심은 The stories(복수)라 are를 쓰고, 이야기가 감동을 '주는' 쪽이라 touching을 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The game excited the fans.
items.s: The fans ___ the game.
items.exp: 경기가 팬들을 신나게 한 것을 팬 입장에서 쓰면 팬들이 신이 난 것이므로 과거분사 excited를 쓰고, 과거·복수 주어라 were를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 엄마는 내 성적에 만족하지 않으셨다.
items.s: Mom ___ my grades.
items.exp: 엄마가 만족을 '느끼는' 쪽이므로 be satisfied with를 쓰고, 과거의 부정이라 was not(wasn't)을 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Knowing not the way, we asked a police officer for help.
Feeling hungry, I made a sandwich for myself.
Not knowing the answer, Jiho kept silent.
Turning to the left, you will see the bank.
Being sick, she stayed in bed all day.
items.exp: 분사구문의 부정은 not을 분사 앞에 써서 Not knowing the way로 나타내야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Walking along the beach, the sun was setting.
Being cold outside, I wore a thick coat.
Listened to music, he did his homework.
Finishing not the work, she couldn't go out.
Hearing the bell, the students ran out of the classroom.
items.exp: 종을 들은 것도, 뛰어나간 것도 학생들이므로 주어가 같아 Hearing the bell이 맞아요. 나머지는 주어 불일치(해가 걷지 않음, 추운 것은 내가 아님), 과거형 Listened, 부정어 위치(Not finishing) 오류예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: While waiting for the bus, I read a book.
After finishing dinner, we went for a walk.
Smiling brightly, the girl waved at me.
Because being tired, he went to bed early.
Having a bad cold, Mina was absent from school.
items.exp: 이유를 나타내는 because는 분사구문 앞에 남기지 않아요. Being tired로 쓰거나 Because he was tired로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Being not hungry, I skipped lunch.
Reading a novel on the sofa, she fell asleep.
Leaving home early, the traffic was not heavy.
Arriving at the station, the train had already left.
Getting up late, so I missed the bus.
items.exp: 소설을 읽은 사람과 잠든 사람이 모두 she라 바르게 쓰였어요. 나머지는 Not being, 주어 불일치(교통이 집을 떠나지 않음), 주어 불일치(역에 도착한 것은 기차가 아님), 분사구문 뒤 so 삭제가 필요해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Taking a taxi, you will get there in ten minutes.
(b) Not having enough money, I couldn't buy the shoes.
(c) Wanted to be a singer, she practiced every day.
(d) Brushing my teeth, the phone rang.
(e) Before going to bed, I always read for an hour.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 택시를 타는 주체와 도착하는 주체가 you로 같음. (b) 옳음: 부정 분사구문 Not having. (c) 틀림: 분사구문은 현재분사로 시작하므로 Wanting. (d) 틀림: 이를 닦은 것은 전화기가 아니라 나이므로 주어가 맞지 않음. (e) 옳음: 의미를 분명히 하려고 접속사 before를 남긴 형태. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Being a good cook, my mom often makes cookies for us.
(b) Feeling not well, he went to see a doctor.
(c) While I walking to school, I met an old friend.
(d) Seeing the police officer, the thief ran away.
(e) Closing my eyes, I took a short nap.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: Because she is a good cook을 줄인 형태. (b) 틀림: 부정어는 분사 앞에 와야 하므로 Not feeling well. (c) 틀림: 주어를 남기려면 was도 필요하므로 While I was walking 또는 While walking. (d) 옳음: 경찰을 본 것과 달아난 것 모두 도둑. (e) 옳음: 눈을 감은 것과 낮잠을 잔 것 모두 나. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (c) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Jumping into the pool, the boy splashed water everywhere.
(b) Being rainy, we canceled the picnic.
(c) After eating lunch, Minsu brushed his teeth.
(d) Not knowing his phone number, I couldn't call him.
(e) Turning on the TV, she sat down on the sofa.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 뛰어든 것과 물을 튀긴 것 모두 소년. (b) 틀림: 비가 온 것은 we가 아니므로 이 형태로 쓸 수 없음(Because it was rainy). (c) 옳음: 접속사 after를 남긴 분사구문. (d) 옳음: 부정 분사구문 Not knowing. (e) 옳음: TV를 켠 것과 앉은 것 모두 she. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Waving her hand, Jenny said goodbye.
(b) Being hungry, the pizza smelled great to me.
(c) Having no time, we took a taxi.
(d) Didn't hear the alarm, I woke up late.
(e) Getting off the bus, I dropped my wallet.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 동시 동작을 나타내는 분사구문. (b) 틀림: 배고픈 것은 피자가 아니라 나이므로 주어가 맞지 않음. (c) 옳음: Because we had no time을 줄인 형태. (d) 틀림: 부정 분사구문은 Not hearing. (e) 옳음: 버스에서 내린 것과 지갑을 떨어뜨린 것 모두 나. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) While watching TV, my dad fell asleep.
(b) Knowing not what to say, I just smiled.
(c) Living in Busan, he can swim very well.
(d) Opening the box, a puppy jumped out.
(e) Cried loudly, the baby woke everyone up.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 접속사 while을 남긴 분사구문. (b) 틀림: 부정어는 분사 앞에 와야 하므로 Not knowing. (c) 옳음: '부산에 살아서'라는 이유의 분사구문. (d) 틀림: 상자를 연 것은 강아지가 아니므로 주어가 맞지 않음. (e) 틀림: 분사구문은 현재분사로 시작하므로 Crying. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 분사구문을 부사절로 바르게 바꾼 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Being busy, I couldn't help him. → Because I was busy
(b) Walking home, I met Ms. Kim. → While I was walking home
(c) Not feeling well, she left early. → Because she felt well
(d) Turning right, you will see the bank. → If you turned right
(e) Hearing the news, he called his mom. → When he hears the news
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 이유의 의미와 시제가 맞음. (b) 옳음: '~하는 동안'의 의미와 시제가 맞음. (c) 틀림: not이 빠져 뜻이 반대가 됨(she didn't feel well). (d) 틀림: 주절이 미래이므로 조건절은 현재시제 If you turn right. (e) 틀림: 주절이 과거이므로 When he heard the news. 따라서 바르게 바꾼 것은 (a), (b)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) (Being / Been) very tired, I went to bed early.
(B) (Not knowing / Knowing not) her address, I couldn't send the card.
items.exp: be동사가 있는 절을 분사구문으로 바꾸면 Being으로 시작하고, 분사구문의 부정은 not을 분사 앞에 써서 Not knowing으로 나타내요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) (Opening / Opened) the window, she felt the cool wind.
(B) (Having / Had) a toothache, Jun went to the dentist.
(C) After (finishing / finished) the test, we went home.
items.exp: 능동의 분사구문은 모두 현재분사로 시작하고, 접속사 After를 남긴 경우에도 뒤에 현재분사 finishing을 써요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 분사구문과 의미가 같은 것은?
<보기> [Feeling tired], I went to bed early.
choices: [Walking down the street], I met my teacher.
[Singing a song], she cleaned her room.
[Opening the door], I saw a strange man.
items.exp: <보기>는 '피곤해서'라는 이유를 나타내요. Having a fever도 '열이 나서'라는 이유이고, 나머지는 때, 동시 동작, 조건, 때를 나타내요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 분사구문과 의미가 다른 것은?
<보기> [Listening to music], he jogged in the park.
choices: [Smiling at me], she shook my hand.
[Being very hungry], I ate two bowls of rice.
[Humming a song], Dad washed the car.
[Holding an umbrella], he walked in the rain.
items.exp: <보기>는 '음악을 들으면서'라는 동시 동작이에요. Being very hungry는 '매우 배가 고파서'라는 이유를 나타내고, 나머지는 모두 동시 동작이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 무엇을 해야 할지 몰라서 선생님께 도움을 요청했다.
items.s: ___, I asked my teacher for help.
items.exp: 이유를 나타내는 분사구문이고, 부정이므로 not을 분사 앞에 써서 Not knowing으로 시작해요. '무엇을 해야 할지'는 what to do예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 분사구문으로 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Because I didn't have an umbrella, I got wet in the rain.
items.s: ___, I got wet in the rain.
items.exp: 접속사와 같은 주어를 빼고, didn't have의 부정은 not을 분사 앞에 두어 Not having으로 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 분사구문으로 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As he was talking on the phone, he crossed the street.
items.s: ___, he crossed the street.
items.exp: 진행형(was talking)을 분사구문으로 바꿀 때는 접속사·주어·be동사를 빼고 현재분사 Talking만 남겨요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 분사구문으로 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Because she was a new student, she didn't know anyone.
items.s: ___, she didn't know anyone.
items.exp: be동사 was가 있는 절이므로 접속사와 주어를 빼고 was를 Being으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: [Watched the news], my parents looked worried. → ___
items.exp: 부모님이 뉴스를 '보는' 능동의 동작이므로 분사구문은 현재분사 Watching으로 시작해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: [Not been] at home, he didn't answer the phone. → ___
items.exp: be동사를 분사구문으로 바꾸면 Being이고, 부정은 앞에 not을 붙여 Not being으로 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I lost my umbrella, so I need to buy a new one.
These boots are too small. Can I try on bigger ones?
I have two sisters. One is a nurse, and the other is a teacher.
This cake is delicious. May I have another piece?
My dad bought me a watch, and I wear one every day.
items.exp: 아빠가 사 주신 바로 그 시계를 가리키므로 one이 아니라 it을 써야 해요. one은 같은 종류의 불특정한 하나를 가리켜요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Of the five boys, two are playing soccer, and the others are reading.
There are three pens. One is red, another is blue, and other is black.
Some people like coffee, and the others like tea.
I don't like this cap. Show me other.
She has a lot of comic books, and she lent it to me.
items.exp: 정해진 다섯 명 중 나머지 전부(세 명)는 the others로 나타내요. 나머지는 the other, others, another, one으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: I have three caps. One is white, and the others are black.
My bike is broken. I'll fix it this weekend.
Would you like another cup of tea?
Some birds can fly, but others can't.
My sneakers are worn out. I need new one.
items.exp: sneakers(복수)와 같은 종류의 '새것'을 가리키므로 new ones로 써야 해요. 단수 one을 쓸 때도 a new one처럼 관사가 필요해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: I have two cousins. One lives in Seoul, and another lives in Ulsan.
Mina's earrings are pretty. I want to buy the same one.
The book I lent you is very old, so please be careful with one.
There were four cookies. I ate one, and my brother ate the others.
One of my two friends lives in Canada, and the other live in Japan.
items.exp: 네 개 중 하나를 뺀 나머지 전부(세 개)이므로 the others가 맞아요. 나머지는 the other, ones, it, lives(the other는 단수)로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: There are five pencils on the desk. One is mine, and the others is Kevin's.
I have two pets. One is a dog, and the other is a hamster.
I don't need this box anymore. You can have it.
These cookies are good. Can I have another?
I lost my cap, so I bought a new one.
items.exp: the others는 '나머지 전부(복수)'이므로 is가 아니라 are를 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I need a pencil. Do you have one?
(b) I bought a new bag, but I lost it on the bus.
(c) Two boys are in the room. One is sleeping, and other is studying.
(d) Some flowers are red, and others are yellow.
(e) She ate a sandwich and then ordered another.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 불특정한 연필 하나라 one. (b) 옳음: 앞의 바로 그 가방이라 it. (c) 틀림: 둘 중 나머지 하나는 the other. (d) 옳음: 불특정한 것들 중 몇몇은 some, 다른 몇몇은 others. (e) 옳음: 같은 종류의 '하나 더'라 another. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I have five coins. One is from China, and the other are from Japan.
(b) My computer is too old. I want a new one.
(c) Of the three bags, one is mine, another is Tom's, and the other is Sue's.
(d) Some like summer, and other like winter.
(e) I like your dress. Where did you buy one?
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 나머지 전부(네 개)는 the others. (b) 옳음: 같은 종류의 불특정한 하나라 one. (c) 옳음: 셋은 one – another – the other. (d) 틀림: '다른 사람들'은 대명사 others. (e) 틀림: 상대방의 바로 그 드레스라 it. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (d), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) There are two bridges. One is old, and the other is new.
(b) He has three sons. One is a doctor, and the others is a pilot.
(c) Your pants are dirty. Change into clean one.
(d) Many people were at the park. Some were jogging, and others were walking their dogs.
(e) I'll give you other chance.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 둘은 one – the other. (b) 틀림: 나머지 두 명(the others)은 복수이므로 the others are pilots. (c) 틀림: pants는 복수 취급이므로 clean ones. (d) 옳음: 불특정한 사람들 중 some – others. (e) 틀림: 단수 명사 앞 '또 하나의'는 another. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This shirt is too big. Do you have a smaller one?
(b) Jake has two cats. One is black, and the other is white.
(c) There are ten students. Six are boys, and the other are girls.
(d) My grandma gave me a scarf, and I wear one on cold days.
(e) Some kids like art, and others like music.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 같은 종류의 불특정한 하나라 one. (b) 옳음: 둘은 one – the other. (c) 틀림: 나머지 전부(네 명)는 the others. (d) 틀림: 받은 바로 그 목도리라 it. (e) 옳음: 불특정한 아이들 중 some – others. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This tea is good. Can I have another cup?
(b) I have three friends. One is from Seoul, other is from Daegu, and the other is from Busan.
(c) The movie was great. I want to see it again.
(d) These are my old sneakers, and those are my new one.
(e) There were six eggs. I used two and kept the others.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: '한 잔 더'라 another. (b) 틀림: 셋 중 두 번째는 another. (c) 옳음: 바로 그 영화라 it. (d) 틀림: sneakers(복수)를 받으므로 ones. (e) 옳음: 나머지 전부(네 개)라 the others. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I can't find my key. Have you seen one?
(b) Some of the balloons are red, and the others are blue.
(c) The pencils are all short. I need new ones.
(d) She has two brothers. One lives in Seoul, and the other lives in Paris.
(e) Would you like other slice of pizza?
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 내가 잃어버린 바로 그 열쇠라 it. (b) 옳음: 정해진 풍선들 중 나머지 전부라 the others. (c) 옳음: pencils와 같은 종류의 여러 개라 ones. (d) 옳음: 둘은 one – the other. (e) 틀림: 단수 명사 앞 '하나 더'는 another. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I lost my pen. I have to buy a new (one / it).
(B) There are two caps. One is yellow, and (another / the other) is green.
(C) Some people walk, and (others / the others) ride bikes.
items.exp: (A) 같은 종류의 새것 하나라 one, (B) 둘 중 나머지 하나라 the other, (C) 불특정한 사람들 중 다른 몇몇이라 others예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I like this bag, but it's too expensive. Can you show me (another / the other)?
(B) Of the six players, two are tall, and (the others / others) are short.
items.exp: (A) 가게에서 같은 종류의 '다른 하나'를 보여 달라는 것이라 another, (B) 정해진 여섯 명 중 나머지 전부라 the others예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> I don't have an eraser. Can I borrow [one]?
choices: This sweater is too small. Do you have a bigger [one]?
[One] day, he met a strange old man.
I bought [one] apple and two bananas.
It takes [one] hour to get there.
items.exp: <보기>의 one은 앞의 명사(an eraser)를 대신하는 부정대명사예요. a bigger one도 sweater를 대신하고, 나머지는 '하나의, 어느'라는 수·형용사로 쓰였어요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 아들이 둘 있는데, 한 명은 키가 크고 나머지 한 명은 키가 작다.
items.s: She has two sons. One is tall, and ___.
items.exp: 둘 중 하나는 one, 나머지 하나는 the other로 나타내고, 단수이므로 is를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 셔츠는 저에게 너무 커요. 더 작은 것을 보여 주시겠어요?
items.s: This shirt is too big for me. Could you ___?
items.exp: 같은 종류의 불특정한 셔츠 하나이므로 one을 쓰고, 형용사가 붙을 때는 a smaller one처럼 관사를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 어떤 학생들은 버스로 등교하고, 또 다른 학생들은 걸어서 등교한다.
items.s: Some students go to school by bus, and ___.
items.exp: 불특정한 학생들 중 몇몇은 some, 다른 몇몇은 others로 나타내요. others는 복수라 walk를 그대로 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Jenny has three pets: one is a dog, another is a cat, and [other] is a rabbit. → ___
items.exp: 셋 중 마지막 남은 하나는 the other로 나타내요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My aunt gave me a nice watch, but I lost [one] at the park. → ___
items.exp: 이모가 준 바로 그 시계를 가리키므로 it을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 열 명의 학생 중 세 명은 안경을 쓰고, 나머지는 모두 안경을 쓰지 않는다.
items.s: Of the ten students, three wear glasses, and ___ glasses.
a: the other seven do not wear
items.exp: 정해진 열 명 중 나머지 전부(일곱 명)는 the others이고, 복수 주어라 do not(don't) wear를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Each of the rooms in this hotel has a nice view.
Every student in my class wants to join the event.
All the milk in the bottle was gone.
Nobody in the team knows the answer.
Both of my parents works at the same hospital.
items.exp: both는 복수 취급하므로 works가 아니라 work를 써야 해요. each of와 every는 단수, 셀 수 없는 명사 앞 all도 단수 취급해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Each boy has his own locker.
Every students have to wear a name tag.
I want to drink cold something.
All of the information were wrong.
Both the girls is good at singing.
items.exp: each 뒤에는 단수 명사와 단수 동사가 오므로 Each boy has가 맞아요. 나머지는 Every student has, something cold, was(information은 셀 수 없음), are로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: Is there interesting anything on TV tonight?
There is something wrong with my computer.
All the students in the room were quiet.
Each of us has a different hobby.
Everyone in my family likes pizza.
items.exp: -thing으로 끝나는 대명사는 형용사가 뒤에서 꾸미므로 anything interesting으로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Every child in the pictures look happy.
All the money in the box was stolen.
Each of the players have a number on the back.
Both of the twins was born in May.
I have nothing special tell you.
items.exp: all 뒤에 셀 수 없는 명사 money가 오면 단수 취급하므로 was가 맞아요. 나머지는 looks, has, were, nothing special to tell로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: All the students have to bring their lunch.
Each of the cookies is shaped like a star.
Every seats on the bus was taken.
Everyone was happy with the result.
Both of my grandparents live in the country.
items.exp: every 뒤에는 단수 명사가 오므로 Every seat로 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Every room in the house has a window.
(b) All of the water in the bottles is cold.
(c) Both of them likes the same singer.
(d) Each student have a locker.
(e) Nobody was in the classroom.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: every+단수 명사, 단수 동사. (b) 옳음: 셀 수 없는 명사 water 앞 all은 단수 취급. (c) 틀림: both는 복수 취급하므로 like. (d) 틀림: each+단수 명사는 단수 취급하므로 has. (e) 옳음: nobody는 단수 취급. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Each of the girls wears a red ribbon.
(b) All the children in the park was playing.
(c) I need something warm to wear.
(d) Everybody in the town know the story.
(e) Both my brother and my sister are tall.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: each of+복수 명사는 단수 취급. (b) 틀림: all+복수 명사는 복수 취급하므로 were. (c) 옳음: -thing+형용사+to부정사 어순. (d) 틀림: everybody는 단수 취급하므로 knows. (e) 옳음: both A and B는 복수 취급. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) There is nothing to eat in the fridge.
(b) Every member of the club has a T-shirt.
(c) All the furniture in the room was new.
(d) Each of the books on the shelf is old.
(e) Both of the bags is too heavy.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: nothing+to부정사. (b) 옳음: every+단수 명사, 단수 동사. (c) 옳음: 셀 수 없는 명사 furniture 앞 all은 단수 취급. (d) 옳음: each of+복수 명사는 단수 취급. (e) 틀림: both는 복수 취급하므로 are. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (d) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Each child was given a gift.
(b) All the teachers in this school is kind.
(c) Do you have anything cold to drink?
(d) Everybody were surprised at the news.
(e) Both of the cups are broken.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: each+단수 명사, 단수 동사 was. (b) 틀림: all+복수 명사는 복수 취급하므로 are. (c) 옳음: -thing+형용사+to부정사 어순. (d) 틀림: everybody는 단수 취급하므로 was. (e) 옳음: both는 복수 취급. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Every day is a new chance.
(b) All the bread on the table are fresh.
(c) Each of my friends has a pet.
(d) No one in my family speak Chinese.
(e) I'm looking for new something.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: every+단수 명사, 단수 동사. (b) 틀림: bread는 셀 수 없는 명사라 all과 써도 단수 취급하므로 is. (c) 옳음: each of+복수 명사는 단수 취급. (d) 틀림: no one은 단수 취급하므로 speaks. (e) 틀림: -thing은 형용사가 뒤에서 꾸미므로 something new. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Each of the students in the class have a tablet.
(b) Both sides of the paper are white.
(c) There's someone strange at the door.
(d) All of my friends was at the party.
(e) Everything in the store is on sale.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: each of+복수 명사는 단수 취급하므로 has. (b) 옳음: both+복수 명사는 복수 취급. (c) 옳음: -one+형용사 어순. (d) 틀림: all+복수 명사는 복수 취급하므로 were. (e) 옳음: everything은 단수 취급. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Each of the students (has / have) a different idea.
(B) All of the cheese (is / are) gone.
(C) Both of my hands (is / are) cold.
items.exp: each of+복수 명사는 단수 취급해 has, 셀 수 없는 명사 cheese 앞 all은 단수 취급해 is, both는 복수 취급해 are예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I want (something sweet / sweet something) to eat.
(B) (Every / All) member of the team was excited.
items.exp: -thing으로 끝나는 대명사는 형용사가 뒤에서 꾸미므로 something sweet, 단수 명사 member와 단수 동사 was가 있으므로 Every예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) There (is / are) nothing important in the box.
(B) All my money (was / were) spent on books.
(C) Each of the boys (bring / brings) his own lunch.
items.exp: nothing은 단수 취급해 is, 셀 수 없는 money 앞 all은 단수 취급해 was, each of+복수 명사는 단수 취급해 brings예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 학생들 각각은 공책을 한 권씩 가지고 있다.
items.s: ___ a notebook.
items.exp: '그 학생들 각각'은 each of the students이고, each of+복수 명사는 단수 취급하므로 has를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 오늘 밤에 할 특별한 일이 아무것도 없다.
items.s: I don't have ___ tonight.
items.exp: 부정문에서는 anything을 쓰고, -thing 대명사는 형용사 special이 뒤에서 꾸민 다음 to부정사 to do가 와요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내 친구들은 모두 이미 그 소식을 들었다.
items.s: ___ the news already.
a: All of my friends have heard
items.exp: all of+복수 명사는 복수 취급하므로 have를 쓰고, already와 함께 완료를 나타내므로 현재완료 have heard를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Every student in the two classes [have] to take the test. → ___
items.exp: every+단수 명사가 주어이면 단수 취급하므로 has를 써요. 바로 앞의 classes에 속지 않도록 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Both of the bridges over the river [was built] in 1990. → ___
items.exp: both는 복수 취급하므로 was가 아니라 were를 써요. 다리는 '지어진' 것이라 수동태는 그대로예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: All the students in this class are kind.
items.s: Every ___ kind.
items.exp: every 뒤에는 단수 명사 student가 오고, 단수 취급하므로 동사도 is로 바꿔요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: He taught himself how to play the guitar.
Please help yourself to the cookies, kids.
We really enjoyed ourselves at the festival.
I cut myself while I was cooking.
items.exp: kids(여러 명)에게 말하므로 yourself가 아니라 yourselves를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: My sister and I did the homework by ourself.
The boys looked at themself in the mirror.
Tom and Mike blamed himself for the mistake.
You should love yourself more, Jina.
items.exp: 한 사람(Jina)에게 말하므로 yourself가 맞아요. 나머지는 ourselves, themselves, themselves, itself로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: Jiho and I enjoyed myself at the party.
Be careful not to hurt yourself.
My grandma always talks to herself when she cooks.
items.exp: 주어 Jiho and I는 '우리'이므로 myself가 아니라 ourselves를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: He looked at himself in the mirror and smiled.
Mom said to us, "Help yourself to the pizza."
I hurt me while I was playing soccer.
items.exp: 주어 He와 목적어가 같으므로 himself가 맞아요. 나머지는 yourselves(us 여러 명에게 한 말), themselves, myself, ourselves로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Kevin taught himself Chinese.
(b) They enjoyed theirselves at the camp.
(c) The machine turns off by itself.
(d) Did you make this cake yourself, Mom?
(e) My brother hurt himself while skating.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: teach oneself는 '독학하다'. (b) 틀림: theirselves라는 형태는 없으므로 themselves. (c) 옳음: by itself는 '저절로'. (d) 옳음: 한 사람에게 말하는 강조 용법 yourself. (e) 옳음: 주어와 목적어가 같아 himself. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Help yourselves to the drinks, everyone.
(b) The singer herself wrote the song.
(c) Sujin and I made dinner for ourself.
(d) Look at yourself! Your face is dirty.
(e) The puppy can't feed itself yet.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 여러 사람(everyone)에게 말하므로 yourselves. (b) 옳음: 주어를 강조하는 herself. (c) 틀림: Sujin and I는 '우리'이므로 ourselves. (d) 옳음: 한 사람에게 말하는 yourself. (e) 옳음: 주어 The puppy와 목적어가 같아 itself. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) We introduced ourselves to the new teacher.
(b) My dad fixed the car by himself.
(c) Ms. Park and her husband built the house themselves.
(d) Please make yourself at home, Mr. and Mrs. Lee.
(e) The girls laughed at themself.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 주어 We와 목적어가 같아 ourselves. (b) 옳음: by oneself는 '혼자서'. (c) 옳음: 복수 주어를 강조하는 themselves. (d) 틀림: 두 사람에게 말하므로 yourselves. (e) 틀림: themself가 아니라 themselves. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The kids enjoyed themselves at the zoo.
(b) Did you hurt yourselves, boys?
(c) He always says to himselves, "I can do it."
(d) My mom and I painted the wall ourselves.
(e) You should be proud of yourself, guys.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: enjoy oneself, 주어가 복수라 themselves. (b) 옳음: 여러 명(boys)에게 말하므로 yourselves. (c) 틀림: himselves라는 형태는 없으므로 himself. (d) 옳음: 주어 My mom and I를 강조하는 ourselves. (e) 틀림: 여러 명(guys)에게 말하므로 yourselves. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The teacher herself answered the phone.
(b) I washed my face and dried me with a towel.
(c) The girls taught themselves to swim.
(d) Ben and Jake asked themselves the same question.
(e) Jiwon cut herselves while cutting paper.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 주어를 강조하는 herself. (b) 틀림: 주어 I와 목적어가 같으므로 myself. (c) 옳음: 주어와 목적어가 같아 themselves. (d) 옳음: 주어 Ben and Jake와 같아 themselves. (e) 틀림: herselves라는 형태는 없으므로 herself. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) We had to do everything for ourselves.
(b) He lives in the big house by himselves.
(c) Please help you to the salad.
(d) The lights turned on by themselves.
(e) My uncle repaired the roof himself.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: for oneself는 '혼자 힘으로'. (b) 틀림: himselves가 아니라 himself. (c) 틀림: help oneself to이므로 yourself. (d) 옳음: 복수 주어 lights라 by themselves. (e) 옳음: 주어를 강조하는 himself. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Children, please help (yourself / yourselves) to the snacks.
(B) Jake fell off his bike and hurt (him / himself).
(C) The door closed by (it / itself).
items.exp: 여러 아이에게 말하므로 yourselves, 넘어져 다친 사람이 Jake 자신이므로 himself, '저절로'는 by itself예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Minho and I enjoyed (ourselves / ourself) at the party.
(B) My sister often talks to (her / herself) while she studies.
items.exp: Minho and I는 '우리'이므로 ourselves, '혼잣말하다'는 talk to oneself라 herself예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> She painted the picture [herself].
items.exp: <보기>의 herself는 주어를 강조하는 강조 용법이라 생략해도 문장이 성립해요. I myself도 강조 용법이고, 나머지는 동사·전치사의 목적어인 재귀 용법이에요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> The boy hurt [himself] on the playground.
choices: Mina looked at [herself] in the window.
items.exp: <보기>의 himself는 동사의 목적어인 재귀 용법이에요. The king himself는 주어를 강조하는 강조 용법이고, 나머지는 모두 목적어 역할의 재귀 용법이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 독학으로 기타 치는 법을 배웠다.
items.s: He ___ the guitar.
items.exp: '독학하다'는 teach oneself이고, 주어가 He이므로 himself, 과거라 taught를 써요. '~하는 법'은 how to play예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 얘들아, 쿠키를 마음껏 먹으렴.
items.s: Kids, ___ the cookies.
items.exp: '마음껏 먹다'는 help oneself to이고, 여러 아이에게 말하므로 yourselves를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 소녀들은 캠프에서 즐거운 시간을 보냈다.
items.s: The girls ___ at the camp.
items.exp: '즐거운 시간을 보내다'는 enjoy oneself이고, 주어가 The girls이므로 themselves, 과거라 enjoyed예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Jisu and her brother made the robot [by herself]. → ___
items.exp: 주어 Jisu and her brother는 복수이므로 by themselves(혼자 힘으로) 또는 강조의 themselves로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.ctx: 아빠는 걱정이 있을 때 항상 혼잣말을 하신다.
items.s: When my dad is worried, he always [talk to him]. → ___
items.exp: '혼잣말하다'는 talk to oneself이고, 주어가 3인칭 단수 he이므로 talks to himself로 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Nobody helped me with the work. I did it alone.
items.s: I did the work ___.
items.exp: 다른 사람의 도움 없이 '혼자 힘으로'는 for oneself이고, 주어가 I이므로 for myself예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: My bag is heavier than yours.
Minho runs as fast as his older brother.
This is the most interesting book that I have ever read.
She is the tallest of the five girls.
This winter is very colder than last winter.
items.exp: very는 비교급을 강조할 수 없으므로 much(even, a lot, far)로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: He speaks English better than his sister does.
This question is more easy than that one.
Seoul is the most big city in Korea.
My room is not as larger as yours.
Jenny is the more famous singer in her country.
items.exp: well의 비교급 better를 than과 함께 바르게 썼어요. 나머지는 easier, the biggest, as large as, the most famous로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: Your idea is much better than mine.
Tom is not as old as Peter.
This is the longest river in the country.
A cheetah can run faster than a lion.
My phone is newer than my sister.
items.exp: 비교 대상은 '내 전화기'와 '언니의 전화기'이므로 my sister가 아니라 my sister's로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: The weather today is as hotter as yesterday.
He is the most happiest boy in the class.
This pencil is longer than that pencil's.
My dog is even smaller than your cat.
Of all the subjects, I like music better.
items.exp: even은 비교급을 강조할 수 있어 even smaller가 맞아요. 나머지는 as hot as, the happiest, that pencil(또는 that one), the best로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Mina is prettier than her sister.
(b) He is the funnyest person in my class.
(c) This movie is more exciting than that one.
(d) I got up more early than my mom.
(e) My shoes are as cheap as yours.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 「자음+y」는 y를 i로 바꿔 prettier. (b) 틀림: funny의 최상급은 funniest. (c) 옳음: 긴 형용사는 more+원급. (d) 틀림: early의 비교급은 earlier. (e) 옳음: as+원급+as, yours=your shoes. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
(b) This bag is a lot heavier than that one.
(c) Health is the more important thing in life.
(d) My score was worse than Jisu.
(e) Her hair is longer than mine.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 장소·집단 범위 앞 in. (b) 옳음: a lot은 비교급 강조 가능. (c) 틀림: '가장 중요한'이므로 the most important. (d) 틀림: 점수끼리 비교하므로 Jisu's. (e) 옳음: mine=my hair. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Which do you like better, cats or dogs?
(b) This is the thinnest book of the three.
(c) The test was very more difficult than I thought.
(d) She has more books than her brother.
(e) The baby is sleeping more quietly than before.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 둘 중 선택은 비교급 better. (b) 옳음: thin은 n을 겹쳐 thinnest, 복수 범위 앞 of. (c) 틀림: very는 비교급을 강조할 수 없으므로 much more difficult. (d) 옳음: many의 비교급 more. (e) 옳음: 부사 quietly의 비교급 more quietly. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Your house is bigger than mine.
(b) Today is the happiest day of my life.
(c) I can't swim as well as my brother.
(d) Tom is more taller than Mike.
(e) This is the most cheapest shirt in the store.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: big은 g를 겹쳐 bigger. (b) 옳음: happy의 최상급 happiest. (c) 옳음: as+원급(well)+as. (d) 틀림: more와 -er을 함께 쓸 수 없으므로 taller. (e) 틀림: most와 -est를 함께 쓸 수 없으므로 the cheapest. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He drives more carefully than his wife.
(b) My grandma is the oldest in my family.
(c) That river is wider than this one.
(d) Her voice is as more beautiful as a bird's.
(e) The second question was more harder than the first.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 부사 carefully의 비교급. (b) 옳음: 집단 범위 앞 in. (c) 옳음: -e로 끝나 -r만 붙인 wider. (d) 틀림: as ~ as 사이에는 원급이므로 as beautiful as. (e) 틀림: more를 빼고 harder. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This tree is the tallest of all the trees in the park.
(b) Mike's grades are better than Jake's.
(c) Jun is the faster runner in our school.
(d) This chair is not as comfortable as that one.
(e) He ate much more than I did.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 복수 범위 앞 of. (b) 옳음: 성적끼리 비교, Jake's=Jake's grades. (c) 틀림: 학교 전체에서 '가장 빠른'이므로 the fastest. (d) 옳음: not as+원급+as. (e) 옳음: much more(훨씬 더 많이). 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) My brother is (very / much) taller than my dad.
(B) This is the (most / more) popular song in Korea.
(C) My dad's car is (old / older) than mine.
items.exp: 비교급 강조는 much, '가장 인기 있는'은 the most popular, than이 있으므로 비교급 older를 써요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Jiho is not as (tall / taller) as Minsu.
(B) Minsu is the (taller / tallest) of the three boys.
(C) So Jiho is (shorter / taller) than Minsu.
items.exp: as ~ as 사이에는 원급 tall, 셋 중 가장 크므로 tallest, 지호는 민수만큼 크지 않으니 민수보다 shorter예요.

items.q: 다음 중 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: Your bike is not as new as mine.
My bike is older than yours.
Your bike is newer than mine.
Your bike is not as old as mine.
My bike is not as new as yours.
items.exp: 나머지는 모두 '네 자전거가 내 것보다 더 새것'이라는 뜻인데, Your bike is not as new as mine은 '내 자전거가 더 새것'이라는 반대의 뜻이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 뜻이 나머지 넷과 다른 문장은?
choices: This quiz was easier than the last one.
This quiz was not as easy as the last one.
The last quiz was more difficult than this one.
This quiz was not as difficult as the last one.
The last quiz was not as easy as this one.
items.exp: 나머지는 모두 '이번 퀴즈가 지난번보다 쉬웠다'는 뜻인데, This quiz was not as easy as the last one은 '이번 퀴즈가 더 어려웠다'는 뜻이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 우리 반에서 가장 키가 큰 학생이다.
items.s: He is ___.
a: the tallest student in my class
the tallest student in our class
items.exp: '가장 키가 큰'은 the tallest이고, 반이라는 집단 범위 앞에는 in을 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: My bag is lighter than yours.
items.s: Your bag is not ___ mine.
items.exp: 내 가방이 더 가볍다는 것은 네 가방이 내 것만큼 가볍지 않다는 뜻이므로 not as(so)+원급+as를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Minsu doesn't swim as well as Jiho.
items.s: Jiho swims ___ Minsu.
items.exp: 민수가 지호만큼 잘 수영하지 못한다는 것은 지호가 더 잘한다는 뜻이고, well의 비교급은 better예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: This is the [most short] way to the station. → ___
items.exp: short는 1음절이라 최상급은 -est를 붙여 shortest예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My grades this year are [higher than my brother]. → ___
items.exp: 비교 대상은 '내 성적'과 '형의 성적'이므로 my brother's로 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 오늘 시험은 어제 시험보다 훨씬 더 어려웠다.
items.s: Today's test ___ yesterday's.
items.exp: 과거의 일이라 was, difficult는 more difficult로 비교급을 만들고 강조는 much를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The more you practice, the better you will play.
She is one of the most famous writer in Korea.
It is getting colder and colder these days.
Please answer the question as quickly as possible.
Our garden is twice as large as theirs.
items.exp: 「one of the+최상급」 뒤에는 복수 명사가 와야 하므로 writers로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The harder you study, the good grades you will get.
The balloon got big and big.
One of the best players on the team are injured.
I ran as fast as I can to catch the bus yesterday.
This bridge is three times longer than that one.
items.exp: 「배수사+비교급+than」으로 바르게 썼어요. 나머지는 the better grades, bigger and bigger, is(주어 One이 단수), could(과거)로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The story became more and more interested.
Your English is getting better and better.
This is one of the busiest cities in the world.
This tower is four times as tall as that building.
items.exp: 이야기가 흥미를 '주는' 쪽이므로 interested가 아니라 interesting을 써서 more and more interesting으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: The more he ate, the fatter got he.
The movie was getting more boring and more boring.
My bag is as twice heavy as yours.
One of my favorite food is pizza.
Dad came home as early as he could yesterday.
items.exp: 과거 문장이므로 as early as possible을 as early as he could로 바르게 썼어요. 나머지는 the fatter he got, more and more boring, twice as heavy as, foods로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: The more often you exercise, the healthier you get.
Smartphones are becoming cheaper and cheaper.
The more I listened to the song, I liked it more.
He is one of the kindest teachers in our school.
Drink as much water as possible.
items.exp: '~할수록 더 …하다'는 「The+비교급 ~, the+비교급 …」이므로 the more I liked it으로 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The older he got, the wiser he became.
(b) Prices are getting higher and higher.
(c) It's one of the most beautiful place in the city.
(d) Come home as soon as possible.
(e) This box is three times as heavier as that one.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: The+비교급 ~, the+비교급 …. (b) 옳음: 비교급+and+비교급. (c) 틀림: one of the+최상급 뒤에는 복수 명사 places. (d) 옳음: as+원급+as possible. (e) 틀림: 배수사+as+원급+as이므로 as heavy as. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The fast you walk, the earlier you arrive.
(b) The better I knew him, the more I liked him.
(c) The weather is getting more and more warm.
(d) One of the students in my class speak French.
(e) Please drive as careful as possible.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 앞에도 비교급이 와야 하므로 The faster. (b) 옳음: The+비교급 ~, the+비교급 …. (c) 틀림: warm은 -er 비교급이므로 warmer and warmer. (d) 틀림: 주어 One이 단수이므로 speaks. (e) 틀림: 동사 drive를 꾸미므로 부사 carefully. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The more you smile, the happier you feel.
(b) Our team got stronger and more strong.
(c) My dad is one of the best cook in town.
(d) Your room is three times as bigger as mine.
(e) Last night I studied as long as I can.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: The+비교급 ~, the+비교급 …. (b) 틀림: 같은 비교급을 반복해 stronger and stronger. (c) 틀림: one of the+최상급 뒤에는 복수 명사 cooks. (d) 틀림: as ~ as 사이에는 원급이므로 as big as. (e) 틀림: 과거 문장이므로 as long as I could. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The higher we climbed, the colder it became.
(b) The days are getting longer and longer.
(c) This island is one of the most popular place for tourists.
(d) Please call me as soon as you can.
(e) This road is three times as long than that one.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: The+비교급 ~, the+비교급 …. (b) 옳음: 비교급+and+비교급. (c) 틀림: one of the+최상급 뒤에는 복수 명사 places. (d) 옳음: as+원급+as+주어+can. (e) 틀림: 배수사+as+원급+as이므로 as long as. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The more careful you are, the fewer mistakes you make.
(b) One of the windows in my room is broken.
(c) It became darker and darker outside.
(d) He spoke as slowly as he could.
(e) The cheap the shoes are, the more people buy them.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the+비교급+명사(fewer mistakes)가 함께 앞으로 나옴. (b) 옳음: 주어 One이 단수라 is. (c) 옳음: 비교급+and+비교급. (d) 옳음: 과거 문장이라 as+원급+as he could. (e) 틀림: 앞에도 비교급이 와야 하므로 The cheaper. 따라서 틀린 것은 (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The earlier you start, the more you can do.
(b) The song is becoming popular and popular.
(c) One of my best friends live next door.
(d) This pool is five times as deep as that one.
(e) Run as fast as possibly.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: The+비교급 ~, the+비교급 …. (b) 틀림: more가 붙는 형용사는 more and more popular. (c) 틀림: 주어 One이 단수이므로 lives. (d) 옳음: 배수사+as+원급+as. (e) 틀림: as+원급+as possible이므로 possible. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The (warm / warmer) it gets, the more people go swimming.
(B) One of the oldest trees in the park (is / are) 300 years old.
(C) This bag is three times as (expensive / more expensive) as that one.
items.exp: The+비교급 구문이므로 warmer, 주어 One이 단수이므로 is, 배수사+as+원급+as이므로 원급 expensive예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Your Korean is getting (better and better / more and more good).
(B) Yesterday I tried to get up as early as I (can / could).
items.exp: good의 비교급은 better이므로 better and better, 과거 문장이므로 as early as I could예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The (long / longer) I waited, the (B)(angry / angrier) I became.
items.exp: 「The+비교급 ~, the+비교급 …」이므로 두 곳 모두 비교급 longer, angrier를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 네가 더 많이 웃을수록, 너는 더 행복해질 것이다.
items.s: The more you smile, ___.
items.exp: 「The+비교급 ~, the+비교급 …」 구문이므로 the happier를 앞에 쓰고, 주어와 동사 you will be를 이어 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He ran as fast as possible.
items.s: He ran ___.
items.exp: as+원급+as possible은 as+원급+as+주어+can으로 바꿀 수 있고, 과거 문장이므로 could를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이 강은 저 강보다 세 배 더 길다.
items.s: This river is ___ that one.
items.exp: 세 배 이상은 「숫자+times」로 나타내고, 원급 비교 as long as와 함께 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: One of the best singers in the world [are] coming to our city. → ___
items.exp: 주어는 One이므로 단수 취급해 is를 써요. 바로 앞의 복수 명사 singers, world에 속지 않도록 해요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The world is getting [hot and hot] every year. → ___
items.exp: '점점 더 ~한'은 「비교급+and+비교급」이고, hot은 t를 겹쳐 hotter예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 날이 어두워질수록, 우리는 더 무서워졌다.
items.s: ___, the more scared we became.
items.exp: 「The+비교급 ~, the+비교급 …」 구문이므로 The darker를 앞에 쓰고, 날씨·명암의 주어 it과 과거 동사 got을 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Both Mina and her sister are good at dancing.
Hurry up, and you will miss the train.
Either you or Tom has to clean the room.
Not only the students but also the teacher was surprised.
My dad as well as my brothers likes baseball.
items.exp: '서둘러라, 그렇지 않으면 기차를 놓칠 것이다'라는 뜻이 되어야 하므로 「명령문, or ~」를 써야 해요. B as well as A는 B(My dad)에 맞춰 likes가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Neither my brother nor I are good at math.
She likes reading, writing, and to draw.
Study hard, or you will pass the test.
Both the cat and the dog is sleeping.
Not only Jiho but also his friends were invited.
items.exp: not only A but also B는 B(his friends)에 동사를 맞추므로 were가 맞아요. 나머지는 am, drawing, and, are로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: My sister as well as I am interested in art.
I was tired, so I went to bed early.
He is not only kind but also smart.
You can either stay here or come with us.
Neither Sam nor his parents know the news.
items.exp: B as well as A는 앞의 B(My sister)에 동사를 맞추므로 am이 아니라 is를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Either you or he have to stay here.
She is not only pretty but also kindness.
He enjoys playing soccer and swim.
Neither the bus nor the trains run on Sundays here.
Not only I but also my sister want a puppy.
items.exp: neither A nor B는 B(the trains)에 동사를 맞추므로 run이 맞아요. 나머지는 has, kind, swimming, wants로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: Both Jun and Mia passed the test.
Not only my uncle but also my aunts lives in Busan.
Neither the teacher nor the students knew the answer.
I like apples, but my brother doesn't.
Be quiet, or the baby will wake up.
items.exp: not only A but also B는 B(my aunts)에 동사를 맞추므로 lives가 아니라 live를 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Both my mom and dad work at a bank.
(b) Not only the boys but also the girl were happy.
(c) Either Jane or her friends are going to call you.
(d) Get up early, and you won't be late.
(e) I like to sing and dancing.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: both A and B는 복수 취급. (b) 틀림: B(the girl)에 맞춰 was. (c) 옳음: B(her friends)에 맞춰 are. (d) 옳음: 「명령문, and ~」는 '그러면'. (e) 틀림: and는 같은 형태를 연결하므로 (to) dance. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) Neither Tom nor I was at home.
(b) Wear a coat, or you will catch a cold.
(c) She can speak English as well as Chinese.
(d) Both Jiho and Minsu wants to be doctors.
(e) He was sick, but he went to school.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: B(I)에 맞춰 was. (b) 옳음: 「명령문, or ~」는 '그렇지 않으면'. (c) 옳음: 같은 품사(명사)를 연결. (d) 틀림: both A and B는 복수 취급하므로 want. (e) 옳음: 반대 내용을 연결하는 but. 따라서 틀린 것은 (d) 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) My friends as well as I am going to the concert.
(b) He neither called nor texted me.
(c) Either Mom or Dad is going to pick me up.
(d) Read the book, and you will understand the story.
(e) Not only he but also his brothers are tall.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: B as well as A는 B(My friends)에 맞춰 are. (b) 옳음: 같은 형태(과거 동사)를 연결. (c) 옳음: B(Dad)에 맞춰 is. (d) 옳음: 「명령문, and ~」는 '그러면'. (e) 옳음: B(his brothers)에 맞춰 are. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (d), (e) 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Not only you but also Jane is invited.
(b) Both he and I am students.
(c) Take a taxi, or you'll be late.
(d) She likes cooking, and he likes eating.
(e) Neither Tom nor his friends was there.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: B(Jane)에 맞춰 is. (b) 틀림: both A and B는 복수 취급하므로 are. (c) 옳음: 「명령문, or ~」는 '그렇지 않으면'. (d) 옳음: 두 절을 and로 연결. (e) 틀림: B(his friends)에 맞춰 were. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Either you or I am wrong.
(b) He is smart, friendly, and honesty.
(c) Not only Minji but also her parents likes K-pop.
(d) The students as well as the teacher were happy.
(e) Be careful, or you will get hurt.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: B(I)에 맞춰 am. (b) 틀림: 형용사끼리 연결해야 하므로 honest. (c) 틀림: B(her parents)에 맞춰 like. (d) 옳음: B as well as A는 B(The students)에 맞춰 were. (e) 옳음: 「명령문, or ~」는 '그렇지 않으면'. 따라서 틀린 것은 (b), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wanted to go out, so it was raining.
(b) Either you or your sister has to answer.
(c) Exercise every day, and you'll be healthier.
(d) She plays not only the piano but also the violin.
(e) Both Sumi and her cousin was born in May.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: '나가고 싶었지만 비가 왔다'는 반대 내용이므로 but. (b) 옳음: B(your sister)에 맞춰 has. (c) 옳음: 「명령문, and ~」는 '그러면'. (d) 옳음: 같은 형태(명사)를 연결. (e) 틀림: both A and B는 복수 취급하므로 were. 따라서 옳은 것은 (b), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
