(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Neither my brother nor I (am / is) a good cook.
(B) My parents as well as my sister (like / likes) hiking.
(C) Leave now, (and / or) you will miss the bus.
items.exp: neither A nor B는 B(I)에 맞춰 am, B as well as A는 B(My parents)에 맞춰 like, '그렇지 않으면'은 or예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) She is both pretty and (kind / kindness).
(B) Either Sam or his parents (is / are) going to come.
items.exp: both A and B는 같은 형태(형용사)를 연결하므로 kind, either A or B는 B(his parents)에 맞춰 are예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Turn right, (and / or) you will see the museum.
(B) Not only you but also he (has / have) to clean the room.
items.exp: '오른쪽으로 돌아라, 그러면 박물관이 보일 것이다'이므로 and, not only A but also B는 B(he)에 맞춰 has예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너뿐만 아니라 나도 그 영화를 보고 싶다.
items.s: ___ to see the movie.
a: I as well as you want
items.exp: 'A뿐만 아니라 B도'는 B as well as A이고, 동사는 앞의 B(I)에 맞춰 want를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: If you don't wear a helmet, you will get hurt.
items.s: Wear a helmet, ___.
items.exp: '~하지 않으면 …할 것이다'는 「명령문, or ~」로 바꿀 수 있어요. If you don't의 부정 의미가 or에 들어 있어요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Jiho doesn't like math. Mina doesn't like math, either.
items.s: ___ math.
items.exp: 'A도 B도 ~ 않다'는 neither A nor B이고, B(단수)에 맞춰 likes를 써요. neither에 부정의 뜻이 있어 doesn't를 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Either my brother or I [are] going to wash the dishes. → ___
items.exp: either A or B는 B(I)에 동사를 맞추므로 am을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: My grandma enjoys gardening, cooking, and [to knit]. → ___
items.exp: and는 같은 형태를 연결하므로 동명사 gardening, cooking과 맞춰 knitting을 써요. enjoy는 동명사를 목적어로 써요.

items.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 형태를 쓰세요.
items.ctx: 그 선생님뿐만 아니라 학생들도 어제 그 소식에 놀랐다.
items.s: Not only the teacher but also the students ___ at the news yesterday.
items.exp: not only A but also B는 B(the students, 복수)에 맞추고, 어제의 일이라 과거, 학생들이 놀람을 느낀 것이라 과거분사 surprised를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I'll call you when I get home.
He has lived here since he was ten.
Because of the heavy snow, the school was closed.
Don't start eating until Dad will come home.
While I was reading, my brother was watching TV.
items.exp: 시간의 부사절에서는 미래의 일도 현재시제로 나타내므로 until Dad comes home으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: We stayed inside because the bad weather.
I have known her since we are children.
After he will finish his homework, he will go out.
I fell asleep during I was watching the movie.
As it was getting dark, we hurried home.
items.exp: as가 '~ 때문에'라는 이유의 접속사로 쓰여 뒤에 절이 왔어요. 나머지는 because of, were, finishes, while로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: I didn't go to school because of I had a cold.
Since I was busy, I couldn't call you.
Before you leave, turn off the lights.
I have been sick since last Monday.
We waited for an hour until the store opened.
items.exp: 뒤에 주어와 동사가 있는 절(I had a cold)이 오므로 because of가 아니라 접속사 because를 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: When I will see him next time, I'll tell him.
She has worked here since she has graduated.
He was late because of he missed the bus.
The phone rang during I was taking a shower.
Let's wait until the rain stops.
items.exp: 시간의 부사절(until ~)에서 미래 대신 현재시제 stops를 바르게 썼어요. 나머지는 see, graduated, because, while로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I'll wait here until you finish the work.
(b) Because it was hot, we went swimming.
(c) He has played the piano since he is five.
(d) While I was walking home, it started to rain.
(e) Because of he was tired, he slept early.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 시간의 부사절에서 미래 대신 현재시제. (b) 옳음: because 뒤에 절. (c) 틀림: '~한 이래로'의 since 절은 과거시제이므로 was. (d) 옳음: while 절에 진행시제. (e) 틀림: 뒤에 절이 오므로 because. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d) 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) After I take a shower, I'll have dinner.
(b) As she was sick, she stayed home.
(c) We have been friends since we met in 2020.
(d) The game was canceled because of the rain.
(e) Before he goes to bed, he always brushes his teeth.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 시간의 부사절에서 미래 대신 현재시제. (b) 옳음: 이유의 as 뒤에 절. (c) 옳음: since 절은 과거시제, 주절은 현재완료. (d) 옳음: because of 뒤에 명사구. (e) 옳음: 습관을 현재시제로 나타냄. 따라서 틀린 것은 없어서 0개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) When the movie will end, we'll go out for dinner.
(b) Since it was Sunday, the bank was closed.
(c) She cried while she was watching the sad movie.
(d) Because the traffic jam, we were late.
(e) I haven't seen him since he moved to another city.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 시간의 부사절이므로 ends. (b) 옳음: 이유의 since 뒤에 절. (c) 옳음: while 절에 진행시제. (d) 틀림: 뒤에 명사구가 오므로 because of. (e) 옳음: since 절은 과거시제, 주절은 현재완료. 따라서 틀린 것은 (a), (d) 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) As soon as I arrive, I will text you.
(b) We couldn't play outside because of the fine dust.
(c) He has been happy since he gets a new bike.
(d) Until the teacher came in, the class was noisy.
(e) I will go out after it will stop raining.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 시간의 부사절에서 미래 대신 현재시제. (b) 옳음: because of 뒤에 명사구. (c) 틀림: since 절은 과거시제이므로 got. (d) 옳음: '~할 때까지'의 until. (e) 틀림: 시간의 부사절이므로 stops. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) While I was cooking, the doorbell rang.
(b) Because she studied hard, she passed the exam.
(c) I'll stay at home until my mom will come back.
(d) She has taught English since she has moved here.
(e) Because of it was cold, I wore a thick jacket.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: while 절에 진행시제. (b) 옳음: because 뒤에 절. (c) 틀림: 시간의 부사절이므로 comes. (d) 틀림: since 절은 과거시제이므로 moved. (e) 틀림: 뒤에 절이 오므로 because. 따라서 틀린 것은 (c), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) He got wet because he didn't have an umbrella.
(b) Since we were young, we have been close.
(c) I will wait until he calls me.
(d) She hurt her leg during she was skiing.
(e) When I was young, I lived in a small town.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: because 뒤에 절. (b) 옳음: since 절은 과거, 주절은 현재완료. (c) 옳음: 시간의 부사절에서 미래 대신 현재시제. (d) 틀림: during은 전치사이므로 절 앞에는 while. (e) 옳음: 과거의 때를 나타내는 when 절. 따라서 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I'll give him the book when he (comes / will come) tomorrow.
(B) We canceled the trip (because / because of) the storm.
(C) She has lived in Seoul (since / for) she was born.
items.exp: 시간의 부사절에서는 미래 대신 현재시제 comes, 명사구 앞에는 because of, '태어난 이래로'는 since예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)의 괄호 안에서 어법에 맞는 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) (While / During) I was in Japan, I learned to cook.
(B) Let's not start the meeting before everyone (arrives / will arrive).
items.exp: 절 앞에는 접속사 While(during은 전치사), 시간의 부사절에서는 미래 대신 현재시제 arrives예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<보기> [Since] it was late, I took a taxi.
choices: I have known him [since] I was eight.
It has been three years [since] we moved here.
[Since] she was very busy, she skipped lunch.
He hasn't eaten anything [since] this morning.
[Since] 2015, she has worked at the bank.
items.exp: <보기>의 since는 '~ 때문에'라는 이유의 접속사예요. '매우 바빠서'의 since도 이유이고, 나머지는 '~ 이래로'라는 시간의 의미예요.

items.q:
<보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것은?
<보기> [As] it was raining, we stayed home.
choices: [As] she was walking home, she saw an accident.
[As] I was tired, I went to bed early.
[As] he was hungry, he ate two hamburgers.
[As] the shop was closed, we went back home.
[As] the bus was late, I missed the class.
items.exp: <보기>의 as는 '~ 때문에'라는 이유예요. '집에 걸어가고 있을 때 사고를 봤다'의 as는 '~할 때'라는 시간의 의미이고, 나머지는 모두 이유예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그녀는 열 살 이후로 이 도시에서 살아왔다.
items.s: She ___ she was ten.
a: has lived in this city since
items.exp: '~한 이래로 (지금까지) 살아왔다'는 현재완료 has lived와 since를 함께 쓰고, since 절에는 과거시제(was)를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 돌아올 때까지 여기서 기다려 줘.
items.s: Please wait here ___.
items.exp: '~할 때까지'는 until이고, 시간의 부사절에서는 미래의 일도 현재시제 come으로 나타내요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Because of the loud noise, I couldn't sleep.
items.s: Because ___, I couldn't sleep.
items.exp: because 뒤에는 절이 와야 하므로 명사구 the loud noise를 주어+동사 the noise was loud로 바꾸고, 과거 문장이라 was를 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I will lend you my bike after I [will finish] my homework. → ___
items.exp: 시간의 부사절(after ~)에서는 미래의 일도 현재시제로 나타내므로 finish를 써요(완료의 의미로 have finished도 가능해요).

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: She fell asleep [during] she was listening to music. → ___
items.exp: during은 전치사라 뒤에 절이 올 수 없어요. '~하는 동안(~할 때)'의 접속사 while(when, as)로 고쳐요.

items.q: 빈칸에 알맞은 형태를 쓰세요.
items.ctx: 엄마가 집에 오시면 우리는 저녁을 먹을 것이다.
items.s: When Mom ___ dinner.
items.exp: 시간의 부사절에서는 미래의 일도 현재시제 comes로 쓰고, 주절은 미래 will have로 써요.

units.name: Ch10-3 조건 · 양보 · 목적/결과의 부사절 접속사

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: Unless it stops snowing soon, the game will be canceled.
She saved money every month so that she could buy a laptop.
It was such a boring movie that I fell asleep.
Even though the test was hard, most students passed it.
If it will be sunny this weekend, we will go camping.
items.exp: 조건을 나타내는 if 부사절에서는 미래의 일이라도 현재시제를 써요. If it will be → If it is가 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Although he was tired, but he helped his mom with the dishes.
The box was so heavy that I couldn't lift it by myself.
The question was too difficult that nobody could answer it.
Despite it was cold, the children played outside.
It was so a nice day that we had lunch in the park.
items.exp: although와 but은 함께 쓰지 않고, 결과는 too가 아니라 so ~ that으로 써요. despite는 전치사라 절이 올 수 없고, 「a+형용사+명사」 앞에는 so가 아니라 such를 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: If the store closes early today, I'll buy the milk tomorrow.
Though my brother is only ten, he cooks very well.
The soup was such hot that I had to wait a few minutes.
Unless you water these plants, they will die soon.
Even if it rains tomorrow, the festival won't be canceled.
items.exp: 명사 없이 형용사만 올 때는 such가 아니라 so를 써요. such hot → so hot이 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: I don't know if he comes to the party tomorrow.
She studied hard in order to she could pass the exam.
He is such kind a person that everyone likes him.
I'll lend you my umbrella if you need it later.
If you will mix blue and yellow, you will get green.
items.exp: know의 목적어인 if절(~인지)은 명사절이라 미래면 will come을 써야 해요. in order to 뒤에는 동사원형(절이면 in order that), such는 such a kind person 어순, 조건 부사절은 현재시제 mix를 써요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Unless you hurry up, you'll be late for the concert.
(b) It was so cold that the lake froze.
(c) Although the shoes were expensive, she bought them.
(d) If he will come back, please tell him to call me.
(e) We whispered so that we wouldn't wake the baby.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: unless = if ~ not. (b) 옳음: so+형용사+that 결과. (c) 옳음: although 양보. (d) 틀림: 조건 부사절은 현재시제 → If he comes back. (e) 옳음: so that 목적, 과거라 would. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) It was such a beautiful view that we took many pictures.
(b) The test was so easy that everyone finished early.
(c) Even though it was late, but the store was still open.
(d) She is so a smart student that she won the prize.
(e) I'll go swimming unless it's too cold.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: such a+형용사+명사+that. (b) 옳음: so+형용사+that. (c) 틀림: even though와 but을 함께 쓰지 않아요. (d) 틀림: so a smart student → such a smart student. (e) 옳음: unless+현재시제. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) If you heat ice, it melts.
(b) In spite of it was raining hard, we went out.
(c) He ran fast so that he could catch the bus.
(d) The music was too loud that I couldn't hear you.
(e) Unless you turn off the light, you can't sleep well.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 일반적 사실의 조건문. (b) 틀림: in spite of는 전치사라 절이 못 와요 → Although it was raining. (c) 옳음: so that+could 목적. (d) 틀림: too ~ that은 없어요 → so loud that. (e) 옳음: 불을 끄지 않으면 잘 못 잔다. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If it snows tomorrow, school will close.
(b) She was such tired that she went to bed early.
(c) Though he had a cold, he went to work.
(d) I turned up the volume so that everyone could hear the song.
(e) Despite he was hungry, he didn't eat anything.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 조건 부사절 현재시제. (b) 틀림: 명사 없는 형용사 앞은 so → so tired. (c) 옳음: though 양보. (d) 옳음: so that 목적. (e) 틀림: despite 뒤에 절 불가 → Although he was hungry. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I'll stay home if it will rain this afternoon.
(b) Unless you practice more, you won't get better.
(c) They were so delicious cookies that I ate them all.
(d) Even if you say sorry, she won't forgive you.
(e) He worked hard so that his family could live well.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 조건 부사절은 현재시제 → if it rains. (b) 옳음: unless+현재. (c) 틀림: 형용사+복수명사 앞은 such → such delicious cookies. (d) 옳음: even if 양보. (e) 옳음: so that 목적. 틀린 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Although the children in this class are young, they read a lot.
(b) The streets were so crowded that we couldn't walk fast.
(c) If my parents comes home late, I cook dinner.
(d) We left early in order that we could avoid the traffic.
(e) Unless he apologizes, I won't speak to him.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 주어 the children(복수) → are. (b) 옳음: so ~ that 결과. (c) 틀림: 주어 my parents가 복수 → come. (d) 옳음: in order that+주어+could 목적. (e) 옳음: unless+현재. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) ___ you don't feel well, you can go home early.
(B) She kept smiling ___ she was very nervous.
items.exp: (A) 뒤에 이미 not이 있으므로 Unless가 아니라 If(몸이 안 좋으면)가 맞아요. (B) 매우 긴장했지만 계속 웃었다는 양보이므로 although예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) It was ___ long trip that we were all tired.
(B) The room was ___ dark that I couldn't find the switch.
items.exp: (A) 「a+형용사+명사」 앞에는 such a를 써서 such a long trip이에요. (B) 형용사만 올 때는 so dark that이에요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 if의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> Call me [if] you need help.
choices: I wonder [if] she remembers my name.
Ask him [if] he can join us.
I'm not sure [if] the shop is open now.
You can borrow my bike [if] yours is broken.
Nobody knows [if] the rumor is true.
items.exp: <보기>의 if는 '만약 ~라면'이라는 조건의 부사절 접속사예요. 'yours is broken' 문장만 조건이고, 나머지는 '~인지'라는 명사절(목적어)을 이끌어요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> The wind was so strong [that] some trees fell down.
choices: The movie [that] we saw was fun.
She was so hungry [that] she ate two bowls of rice.
It is true [that] he moved to Jeju.
items.exp: <보기>는 so ~ that 결과 구문의 that이에요. 'so hungry that' 문장만 같아요. I think that·It is true that은 명사절 접속사, The movie that은 관계대명사, That bag은 지시형용사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내일 비가 오지 않으면, 우리는 소풍을 갈 것이다.
items.s: ___ tomorrow, we will go on a picnic.
items.exp: '~하지 않으면'은 unless로 쓰고, 조건 부사절이라 미래라도 현재시제 rains를 써요. unless 뒤에 not을 또 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그것은 너무 웃긴 이야기여서 우리는 웃음을 멈출 수 없었다.
items.s: It was ___ that we couldn't stop laughing.
items.exp: 「a+형용사+명사」가 오므로 so가 아니라 such a funny story that ~ 구문을 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: He got up early in order to see the sunrise.
items.s: He got up early so that ___ the sunrise.
items.exp: in order to(목적)는 so that+주어+can으로 바꿀 수 있어요. 주절이 과거(got)이므로 could를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The water was too cold for us to swim in.
items.s: The water was so cold that ___ in it.
items.exp: too ~ for 사람 to부정사는 so ~ that+주어+can't로 바꿔요. 과거 문장이므로 couldn't를 쓰고, to부정사의 의미상 주어 us는 주어 we가 돼요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: If my brother [will finish] his homework early, he will watch a movie. → ___
items.exp: 조건 부사절에서는 미래 대신 현재시제를 쓰고, 주어 my brother가 3인칭 단수이므로 finishes예요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 동사를 문맥에 맞게 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 다리는 겨우 작년에 지어졌지만, 벌써 수리가 필요하다.
items.s: Although the bridge ___ only last year, it already needs repairs.
items.exp: 다리는 '지어진' 대상이므로 수동태, last year가 있으므로 과거시제 was built예요. although 양보절은 시제를 그대로 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It is surprising that she finished the race.
I wonder whether he got my message.
Do you think where she bought the shoes?
Can you tell me who broke the window?
Whether he will come or not is not important.
items.exp: think처럼 생각을 나타내는 동사가 있는 의문문에서는 의문사를 문장 맨 앞에 써요. → Where do you think she bought the shoes?

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I'm not sure if or not the bus has left.
Do you know what time does the museum open?
That they lost the game were a big shock to the fans.
The question is whether we can finish it by Friday.
Please tell me where can I buy the tickets.
items.exp: if 바로 뒤에는 or not을 쓸 수 없고, 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순(what time the museum opens, where I can buy)이에요. that절 주어는 단수 취급 → was예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: We talked about if we should move to a new city.
I don't know if she will call me tonight.
What do you think he wants for his birthday?
It is clear that the plan won't work.
My hope is that we can meet again soon.
items.exp: 전치사 뒤에는 if절을 쓸 수 없고 whether를 써요. → talked about whether. know의 목적어인 if절은 명사절이라 will을 쓸 수 있어요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: Do you know who is that tall girl?
I asked her that she could help me.
It is true what he lied to us.
I wonder whether or not did he lock the door.
Who do you guess will win the game?
items.exp: guess는 생각 동사라 의문사 Who가 맨 앞에 오고, Who가 주어이므로 바로 will win이 와요. 나머지는 who that tall girl is, asked her if, It is true that, whether or not he locked가 맞아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I'm not sure whether she likes spicy food.
(b) Can you tell me how much this shirt costs?
(c) Do you know why was she angry?
(d) It was lucky that nobody got hurt.
(e) That the earth goes around the sun is a fact.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: whether+주어+동사. (b) 옳음: how much+주어+동사. (c) 틀림: 간접의문문 어순 → why she was angry. (d) 옳음: 가주어 It, 진주어 that절. (e) 옳음: that절 주어는 단수 → is. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I wonder if will it snow on Christmas.
(b) What do you know she is cooking?
(c) Tell me whether you agree with me or not.
(d) The problem is that we don't have a map.
(e) I want to know if or not he is ready.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: if+주어+동사 → if it will snow. (b) 틀림: know는 생각 동사가 아니라 의문사를 앞으로 보내지 않아요 → Do you know what she is cooking? (c) 옳음: whether ~ or not. (d) 옳음: 보어 that절. (e) 틀림: if or not 불가 → whether or not. 따라서 틀린 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) Do you think who will be the next captain?
(b) That she won first prize surprised everyone.
(c) I can't remember where I put my glasses.
(d) Whether we go or stay depend on the weather.
(e) Nobody knows how old the tree is.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: 생각 동사 think → Who do you think will be ~? (b) 옳음: 주어 that절. (c) 옳음: where+주어+동사. (d) 틀림: whether절 주어는 단수 → depends. (e) 옳음: how old+주어+동사. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wonder what she is drawing.
(b) Do you know where does Minho live?
(c) It is a pity that you can't come.
(d) Whether it is true is not clear yet.
(e) He asked me that I had eaten lunch.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: what+주어+동사. (b) 틀림: → where Minho lives. (c) 옳음: 가주어 It ~ that. (d) 옳음: whether절은 주어 자리에 올 수 있어요. (e) 틀림: ask는 '~인지' 묻는 것이므로 that이 아니라 if/whether. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) What do you think is the best way to learn English?
(b) I'm worried about whether I can pass the test.
(c) Please let me know when will you arrive.
(d) That he told a lie are clear.
(e) Do you know who made this delicious cake?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: think 의문문은 의문사가 맨 앞, What이 주어라 is가 바로 와요. (b) 옳음: 전치사 뒤 whether는 가능. (c) 틀림: → when you will arrive. (d) 틀림: that절 주어는 단수 → is. (e) 옳음: 의문사 who가 주어라 「의문사+동사」. 틀린 것은 (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The truth is that I broke your cup.
(b) Can you tell me if is there a bank near here?
(c) I don't know whose umbrella this is.
(d) It is strange which he didn't say goodbye.
(e) How do you think she solved the puzzle?
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 보어 that절. (b) 틀림: → if there is a bank. (c) 옳음: whose umbrella+주어+동사. (d) 틀림: 진주어는 which가 아니라 that절. (e) 옳음: think 의문문은 의문사가 맨 앞. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I wonder ___ you want to come with us.
(B) The plan depends on ___ we have enough money.
items.exp: (A) wonder 뒤에는 '~인지'를 뜻하는 if/whether가 오고 that은 쓰지 않아요. (B) 전치사 on 뒤에는 if를 쓸 수 없어서 whether예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Can you tell me ___?
(B) ___ do you think will win the singing contest?
choices: where is the post office – Who
where the post office is – Who
where the post office is – Do
the post office is where – Who
where is the post office – Do
items.exp: (A) 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이라 where the post office is예요. (B) think가 있는 의문문은 의문사 Who를 맨 앞에 써요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 That(that)의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> [That] he passed the test made his parents happy.
choices: The trouble is [that] I lost my key.
Look at [that] dog under the tree.
The pizza [that] we ordered was cold.
He was so tired [that] he fell asleep.
This is the bike [that] my uncle gave me.
items.exp: <보기>의 That은 명사절을 이끄는 접속사예요. 'The trouble is that ~'의 that도 보어 명사절을 이끌어요. 나머지는 지시형용사, 관계대명사, so ~ that 결과의 that이에요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 It의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> [It] is certain that he will be late.
choices: [It] is not easy to learn Chinese.
[It] was Mina that broke the vase.
items.exp: <보기>의 It은 뒤의 진주어(that절)를 대신하는 가주어예요. 'It is not easy to learn ~'의 It도 진주어 to부정사를 대신하는 가주어예요. 나머지는 대명사, 비인칭 주어, 강조 구문의 It이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그녀가 왜 울고 있었는지 모른다.
items.s: I don't know ___.
items.exp: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이고, '울고 있었는지'이므로 과거진행형 was crying을 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 너는 누가 그 창문을 깼다고 생각하니?
items.s: ___ the window?
items.exp: think가 있는 의문문은 의문사를 맨 앞에 써요. Who가 주어이므로 「Who+do you think+동사」, 과거이므로 broke예요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I want to know. + Is she coming to the party?
items.s: I want to know ___ to the party.
items.exp: 의문사가 없는 의문문은 「if+주어+동사」로 바꾸고, 의문문 어순(Is she)을 평서문 어순(she is)으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Do you know? + Where did he hide the key?
items.s: Do you know ___ the key?
items.exp: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이에요. did가 사라지면서 과거시제가 동사로 옮겨가 hide → hid가 돼요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: Do you know when [does the next train leave]? → ___
items.exp: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이에요. does를 빼고 주어 the next train에 맞춰 leaves로 써요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 동사를 문맥에 맞게 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 그 편지가 어제 보내졌는지 확신하지 못한다.
items.s: I'm not sure whether the letter ___ yesterday.
items.exp: 편지는 '보내지는' 대상이므로 수동태이고 yesterday가 있으므로 과거시제 was sent예요. whether절 안에서는 평서문 어순을 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The girl who lives next door plays the violin.
I have a bag which has a lot of pockets.
The boys who are playing soccer looks very happy.
Do you know the man that is talking to Ms. Kim?
We stayed at a hotel which was near the beach.
items.exp: 문장 전체의 주어는 The boys(복수)이므로 동사는 look이어야 해요. 관계대명사절(who are playing soccer)은 주어를 꾸밀 뿐이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The dog which bark every night belongs to my neighbor.
I met a woman who she works at the zoo.
The pictures that hangs on the wall were painted by my aunt.
He bought a phone which can take great pictures.
This is the boy which won the singing contest.
items.exp: 주격 관계대명사 뒤 동사는 선행사에 수를 맞추고(The dog → barks, The pictures → hang), 관계대명사가 주어이므로 she를 또 쓰지 않아요. 사람 선행사에는 which가 아니라 who/that을 써요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The cookies which were on the plate disappeared.
The students who were late was told to stay after class.
A boy who has a red cap is waving at us.
The bus that goes to the airport leaves every hour.
Anyone who wants to join the club can sign up here.
items.exp: 주어 The students가 복수이므로 수동태도 were told가 되어야 해요. 관계대명사절의 were만 맞추고 본동사를 놓치기 쉬워요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: I like stories who have happy endings.
The woman who teach us science is very kind.
The movie which were shown last night was boring.
Look at the birds that is flying over the lake.
The people who live in this village are friendly.
items.exp: 사물 선행사 stories에는 which/that, The woman은 단수라 teaches, The movie는 단수라 was shown, the birds는 복수라 are flying이 맞아요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I have a friend who can speak three languages.
(b) The trees which grows near the river are very old.
(c) She is the teacher that helped me a lot.
(d) The house which stands on the hill is my uncle's.
(e) The girl who is wearing glasses she is my cousin.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 선행사 The trees가 복수 → grow. (c) 옳음: that은 사람 선행사에도 가능. (d) 옳음: The house 단수 → stands. (e) 틀림: 주어 The girl을 she로 반복 → The girl who is wearing glasses is ~. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The man who fixed my bike was very kind.
(b) Tom has two sisters who work at a bank.
(c) The letter which came this morning is from Jiho.
(d) Who is the girl that is standing by the door?
(e) The books which is on my desk are not mine.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: two sisters 복수 → work. (c) 옳음: The letter 단수 → came/is. (d) 옳음: 의문사 Who로 시작하는 문장에서는 관계대명사 that을 써요. (e) 틀림: 선행사 The books 복수 → are. 따라서 틀린 것은 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The robot which cleans the floor is very quiet.
(b) The players who won the game was given medals.
(c) I know a girl who wants to be a pilot.
(d) The bridge that connects the two towns is very long.
(e) The kids who are swimming in the pool look excited.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 주어 The players 복수 → were given. (c) 옳음: a girl 단수 → wants. (d) 옳음: The bridge 단수 → connects/is. (e) 옳음: The kids 복수 → are/look. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The bag which is on the chair is Mina's.
(b) I have an uncle who he is a firefighter.
(c) The flowers that grow in this garden smell good.
(d) The man who are sitting on the bench is my coach.
(e) A dictionary is a book that tells you the meanings of words.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 관계대명사가 주어이므로 he 삭제. (c) 옳음: The flowers 복수 → grow/smell. (d) 틀림: The man 단수 → is sitting. (e) 옳음: a book 단수 → tells. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The children who live on this street go to the same school.
(b) The pen which were on the desk was mine.
(c) I met a girl who was carrying a big box.
(d) A cat that have green eyes came into my yard.
(e) This is the train that goes to Busan.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: The children 복수 → live/go. (b) 틀림: The pen 단수 → was. (c) 옳음. (d) 틀림: A cat 단수 → has. (e) 옳음. 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wonder who left this note on my desk.
(b) The girl who sings in the choir has a beautiful voice.
(c) The shoes which is in the box are new.
(d) The man that stole the money were caught.
(e) We need a person who can drive a bus.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 의문사 who가 주어인 간접의문문. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: The shoes 복수 → are in the box. (d) 틀림: The man 단수 → was caught. (e) 옳음. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The woman ___ lives upstairs is a nurse.
(B) I want a jacket ___ keeps me warm.
items.exp: (A) 사람 선행사이고 관계대명사가 주어 역할이므로 who, (B) 사물 선행사이므로 which예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The boy who ___ next to me in class is from Canada.
(B) The boxes which ___ in the hall must be moved.
items.exp: 주격 관계대명사 뒤 동사는 선행사에 수를 맞춰요. (A) The boy(단수) → sits, (B) The boxes(복수) → are예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 who의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> The boy [who] is holding the ball is my brother.
choices: I have a friend [who] sings very well.
items.exp: <보기>의 who는 선행사 The boy를 꾸미는 주격 관계대명사예요. 'a friend who sings'만 관계대명사이고, 나머지는 '누구'라는 의문사예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> This is the road [that] leads to the lake.
choices: The car [that] is parked outside is new.
The road was so icy [that] we drove slowly.
items.exp: <보기>의 that은 주격 관계대명사예요. 'The car that is parked'만 같고, 나머지는 명사절 접속사, 지시대명사, 결과의 that이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 벽에 걸려 있는 그 그림들은 아주 오래되었다.
items.s: The pictures ___ on the wall are very old.
items.exp: 사물 선행사이므로 which를 쓰고, 선행사 The pictures가 복수이므로 hang이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 대회에서 우승한 소녀들은 상을 받았다.
items.s: The girls ___ got prizes.
items.exp: 사람 선행사이므로 주격 관계대명사 who를 쓰고, 과거의 일이므로 won이에요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I know a man. + He has visited fifty countries.
items.s: I know a man ___ fifty countries.
items.exp: 두 번째 문장의 주어 He를 주격 관계대명사 who로 바꿔요. 시제(현재완료)와 수(단수 has)는 그대로 유지해요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The bus was full. + It goes to the stadium.
items.s: The bus ___ to the stadium was full.
items.exp: It(=The bus)을 주격 관계대명사 that으로 바꾸고, 선행사 The bus 바로 뒤에 넣어요. 단수이므로 goes예요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The students who [has] finished the test may leave the room. → ___
items.exp: 주격 관계대명사 뒤의 동사는 선행사 The students(복수)에 맞춰 have를 써요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 동사를 문맥에 맞게 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 학생들이 어제 부른 그 노래는 아름다웠다.
items.s: The song which ___ by the students yesterday was beautiful.
items.exp: 노래는 '불려진' 대상이므로 수동태, yesterday가 있으므로 과거, 선행사가 단수이므로 was sung이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: The cake which my dad made was delicious.
I have a friend whose father is a pilot.
This is the chair on which my grandpa used to sit.
The movie that we watched it last night was scary.
The girl whom I met at the camp sent me a card.
items.exp: 목적격 관계대명사 that이 이미 watched의 목적어 역할을 하므로 it을 또 쓰면 안 돼요. → The movie that we watched last night was scary.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: The house in that my parents grew up is very old.
I know a boy who mother teaches English.
The bag which I bought it online was too small.
The music which we listened was relaxing.
The woman whose car was stolen called the police.
items.exp: 전치사 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없고(in which), '그의 어머니'는 소유격 whose, 목적어 it은 중복이에요. listen은 자동사라 listened to가 있어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The books which my teacher recommended are on sale now.
The boy whose shoes are muddy has to clean them.
The songs that the band played tonight was amazing.
The town in which I was born is very small.
The teacher whom many students like is Mr. Han.
items.exp: 주어는 The songs(복수)이므로 본동사는 were여야 해요. 관계대명사절 속 the band(단수)에 끌려 was를 쓰면 안 돼요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: The friend with whom I went to the museum is Sora.
The restaurant which we had dinner was crowded.
I saw a house which roof was painted blue.
This is the girl whose I told you about.
The pen that I was writing with it is broken.
items.exp: 「전치사+whom」은 바른 형태예요. 나머지는 at which(또는 which ~ at), whose roof, who/whom/that, it 삭제가 필요해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The man that I saw at the bank was my uncle.
(b) I have a cat whose eyes are blue.
(c) This is the box in that I keep my letters.
(d) The pizza which we ordered it was cold.
(e) The girl whom we invited came late.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 목적격 that. (b) 옳음: 소유격 whose+명사. (c) 틀림: 전치사 뒤에 that 불가 → in which. (d) 틀림: 목적어 it 중복. (e) 옳음: 목적격 whom. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The boy whose bike was stolen looked sad.
(b) The dress which she wore at the party were pretty.
(c) The topic about which we talked was interesting.
(d) This is the friend I always play with.
(e) The singer whose songs I like is coming to Korea.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 주어 The dress 단수 → was. (c) 옳음: 전치사+which. (d) 옳음: 목적격 관계대명사 생략, 전치사 with는 끝에 남아요. (e) 옳음: whose songs가 like의 목적어 역할. 따라서 틀린 것은 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) She is the doctor whom the patients love her.
(b) The game which we played yesterday was exciting.
(c) This is the hotel at which we stayed last summer.
(d) The man whose house is next to ours is a farmer.
(e) The letter which my aunt sent to me arrived today.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: whom이 love의 목적어이므로 her 중복 → whom the patients love. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: 전치사+which. (d) 옳음: whose house. (e) 옳음. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I know a girl whose brother is a famous cook.
(b) The song which I wanted to hear it was not played.
(c) The park which we walked through was beautiful.
(d) The city in which she lives is near the sea.
(e) The dog whose I found was very small.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: whose+명사. (b) 틀림: hear의 목적어 it 중복. (c) 옳음: through의 목적어 which, 전치사는 뒤에 남아요. (d) 옳음: 전치사+which. (e) 틀림: 뒤에 명사가 없으므로 whose 불가 → which/that. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The room which windows face south is warm.
(b) The teacher to whom I sent the email replied quickly.
(c) The pictures that you took in Jeju are great.
(d) The chair on which I sat on was broken.
(e) The man that you met yesterday is my coach.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: '그 방의 창문'이므로 whose windows. (b) 옳음: 전치사+whom. (c) 옳음: 목적격 that. (d) 틀림: on을 두 번 씀 → on which I sat. (e) 옳음: 목적격 that. 틀린 것은 (a), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) Jiho has a sister whose hobby is baking.
(b) The pants which I bought last week is too long.
(c) The kids with whom my son plays are kind.
(d) The story which my grandma told me it was funny.
(e) The museum that we visited had many old coins.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: whose hobby. (b) 틀림: pants는 복수 취급 → are. (c) 옳음: 전치사+whom, 주어 The kids → are. (d) 틀림: told의 목적어 it 중복. (e) 옳음. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I have a friend ___ dream is to be a vet.
(B) This is the house in ___ the old writer lived.
items.exp: (A) 뒤에 명사 dream이 오고 '그 친구의 꿈'이므로 소유격 whose, (B) 전치사 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없어 which예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The bike ___ I borrowed from Jun has a flat tire.
(B) The cookies which my mom made ___ all gone.
items.exp: (A) 사물 선행사이고 borrowed의 목적어 역할이므로 which, (B) 본동사의 주어는 The cookies(복수)이므로 are예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 that의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> The cake [that] you made was delicious.
choices: She said [that] the test was easy.
The jacket [that] I wanted was sold out.
It was so cold [that] the pipes froze.
items.exp: <보기>의 that은 made의 목적어 역할을 하는 목적격 관계대명사예요. 'The jacket that I wanted'만 같고, 나머지는 명사절 접속사, 결과의 that, 지시형용사예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 which의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> This is the song [which] I listen to every day.
choices: [Which] do you like better, tea or coffee?
I can't decide [which] I should buy.
The bag [which] she is carrying is heavy.
items.exp: <보기>의 which는 선행사 the song을 꾸미는 관계대명사예요. 'The bag which she is carrying'만 같고, 나머지는 '어느 것/어느'라는 의문사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이것은 내가 지난주에 잃어버린 카메라이다.
items.s: This is the camera ___ last week.
items.exp: 사물 선행사이고 lost의 목적어 역할이므로 목적격 관계대명사 which를 써요. 목적어 it을 또 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 나는 지붕이 빨간 집에 산다.
items.s: I live in a house ___.
items.exp: '그 집의 지붕'이므로 소유격 관계대명사 whose 뒤에 명사 roof를 바로 써요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: This is the town. + My grandparents live in the town.
items.s: This is the town in ___.
items.exp: in the town의 the town을 관계대명사로 바꾸고 전치사를 앞으로 보내요. 전치사 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 in which예요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The girl is my classmate. + I talked with her at the bus stop.
items.s: The girl with ___ at the bus stop is my classmate.
items.exp: with her의 her를 관계대명사로 바꾸고 전치사 with를 앞으로 보내요. 전치사 바로 뒤 사람 선행사에는 whom을 써요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: The man [which] house is next to the bakery is a chef. → ___
items.exp: 뒤에 명사 house가 오고 '그 남자의 집'이라는 소유 관계이므로 whose를 써요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 동사를 문맥에 맞게 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 작가가 쓴 책들은 많은 나라에서 읽힌다.
items.s: The books which the writer wrote ___ in many countries.
items.exp: 본동사의 주어는 The books(복수)이고 책은 '읽히는' 대상이므로 현재 수동태 are read예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: What she cooked for us was really delicious.
The boy standing at the gate is my cousin.
This is the watch my uncle gave me.
I can't find the key what I put on the table.
Show me what you have in your pocket.
items.exp: 선행사 the key가 있으므로 선행사를 포함한 what은 쓸 수 없어요. → the key which(that) I put, 또는 which/that을 생략해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: What I need right now are some sleep.
The house built by my grandpa still stands.
He is a man loves animals.
This is the town in I grew up.
The girl sings on the stage is my sister.
items.exp: built by my grandpa는 which was가 생략된 과거분사구예요. what절 주어는 단수(is), 주격 관계대명사는 단독으로 생략 불가(who loves, who is singing/singing), 전치사 뒤 관계대명사도 생략 불가(in which)예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The things what you need for the trip are on the list.
The man I talked to was very friendly.
The letters written in English were hard to read.
What surprised me most was his kindness.
The baby sleeping in the bed is my nephew.
items.exp: 선행사 The things가 있으므로 what이 아니라 which/that을 쓰거나 생략해요. → The things (that) you need ~.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: This is that I wanted for my birthday.
The boy broken the window ran away.
I didn't believe what he told me.
The pictures taking by Yuna won a prize.
What the students want are more free time.
items.exp: 선행사가 없으므로 what(~하는 것)이 맞아요. 나머지는 that → what, broken → who broke, taking → taken, are → is로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) What you said made me happy.
(b) The bridge built last year is very long.
(c) The woman sitting next to me was reading a book.
(d) I lost the umbrella what I bought yesterday.
(e) This is exactly what I was looking for.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: what절 주어. (b) 옳음: 다리는 '지어진' 것 → built. (c) 옳음: 앉아 있는 → sitting. (d) 틀림: 선행사 the umbrella가 있으므로 what 불가 → which/that. (e) 옳음: 선행사 없는 what. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The dog barking loudly belongs to Mr. Park.
(b) What I like about her is her smile.
(c) The cake made by my sister were sweet.
(d) The boy is playing the drums is Junho.
(e) Tell me the thing that you heard.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 짖고 있는 → barking. (b) 옳음: what절 주어는 단수 → is. (c) 틀림: 주어 The cake 단수 → was. (d) 틀림: 「관계대명사+be동사」를 생략할 때는 둘 다 생략 → The boy playing the drums (또는 who is playing). (e) 옳음: the thing that. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The book I borrowed from the library is due today.
(b) The language speaking in Brazil is Portuguese.
(c) What we saw in the forest were amazing.
(d) He gave me what I really wanted.
(e) The girl whose I met at the party was nice.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 목적격 관계대명사 생략. (b) 틀림: 언어는 '말해지는' 것 → spoken. (c) 틀림: what절 주어는 단수 → was. (d) 옳음: what = the thing which. (e) 틀림: 뒤에 명사가 없으므로 whose 불가 → who(m)/that 또는 생략. 따라서 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 부분을 생략할 수 있는 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The song [that] we sang together was fun.
(b) The man [who] lives upstairs is a pilot.
(c) The girl [who is] dancing on the stage is Mina.
(d) This is the house in [which] I was born.
(e) I have a friend [whose] mom is a teacher.
items.exp: (a) 가능: 목적격 관계대명사. (b) 불가: 주격 관계대명사는 단독 생략 불가. (c) 가능: 「주격 관계대명사+be동사」. (d) 불가: 전치사 바로 뒤 관계대명사. (e) 불가: 소유격 whose. 생략 가능한 것은 (a), (c)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) What he wants to be is a vet.
(b) Everything that she said was true.
(c) The bag what she bought was expensive.
(d) The car parked in front of my house is not mine.
(e) The bread baking this morning smells good.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: what절 주어, 단수 is. (b) 옳음: everything 뒤에는 that. (c) 틀림: 선행사 The bag이 있으므로 what 불가. (d) 옳음: 주차된 → parked. (e) 틀림: 빵은 '구워진' 것 → baked. 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I don't understand what you mean.
(b) The cookies my mom baked smells great.
(c) The woman wearing a red hat is my aunt.
(d) This is the bag I put my phone in.
(e) What I want are a long vacation.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: what = the thing which. (b) 틀림: 주어 The cookies 복수 → smell. (c) 옳음: 쓰고 있는 → wearing. (d) 옳음: 목적격 생략, 전치사 in은 끝에 남아요. (e) 틀림: what절 주어는 단수 → is. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) ___ he told me was a secret.
(B) The secret ___ he told me was surprising.
items.exp: (A) 선행사가 없고 told의 목적어가 빠진 '그가 말한 것'이므로 What, (B) 선행사 The secret이 있으므로 that이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) The boy ___ by the dog was taken to the hospital.
(B) The girl ___ the piano in the hall is my sister.
items.exp: (A) 소년은 개에게 '물린' 것이므로 과거분사 bitten, (B) 소녀가 피아노를 '치고 있는' 것이므로 현재분사 playing이에요. 둘 다 「관계대명사+be동사」가 생략된 형태예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 what의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> [What] she said made everyone laugh.
choices: Thank you for [what] you did for me.
items.exp: <보기>의 What은 '~하는 것'이라는 관계대명사예요. 'what you did for me(네가 나를 위해 해 준 것)'만 같고, 나머지는 의문사이거나 감탄문의 What이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 생략할 수 없는 것은?
choices: The doctor [who] treated me was kind.
The movie [that] we watched was long.
The boy [who is] reading a comic book is Jisu.
This is the pen [which] I lost.
The letter [which was] written by Ann made me cry.
items.exp: 주격 관계대명사 who는 단독으로 생략할 수 없어요. 나머지는 목적격 관계대명사이거나 「주격 관계대명사+be동사」라서 생략할 수 있어요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그가 어제 나에게 보여 준 것은 오래된 지도였다.
items.s: ___ was an old map.
items.exp: '~한 것'은 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what으로 나타내고, what절이 주어이므로 단수 동사 was가 와요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 가게에서 팔리는 빵은 매우 신선하다.
items.hint: sell 활용, at the store 포함, 관계대명사 없이 4단어
items.s: The bread ___ is very fresh.
items.exp: 빵은 '팔리는' 것이므로 과거분사 sold를 써요. which is가 생략된 형태예요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I didn't understand the things that the teacher explained.
items.s: I didn't understand ___.
items.exp: the things that은 선행사를 포함한 관계대명사 what 하나로 바꿀 수 있어요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: The woman who is talking on the phone is my mom.
items.s: The woman ___ is my mom.
items.exp: 「주격 관계대명사+be동사」(who is)는 함께 생략할 수 있어서 현재분사구 talking on the phone이 남아요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: What I learned from the trip [were] very useful. → ___
items.exp: 관계대명사 what이 이끄는 절이 주어일 때는 단수 취급하므로 was를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 엄마가 오늘 아침에 구운 쿠키들은 벌써 다 없어졌다.
items.hint: Mom을 주어로, bake·be 활용, 관계대명사 생략, 5단어
items.s: The cookies ___ already gone.
items.exp: 목적격 관계대명사를 생략하고 「주어+동사」(Mom baked)를 바로 써요. 본동사의 주어는 The cookies(복수)이므로 are예요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I remember the summer when we went to Jeju.
This is the café where my sister works.
Nobody knows the reason why she left early.
Tell me the way how you made this robot.
That is how I learned to ride a bike.
items.exp: the way와 how는 함께 쓸 수 없어요. → the way you made 또는 how you made로 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: This is the museum where has many old paintings.
Do you know the reason for which he got angry?
I'll never forget the day which I met you first.
The village where my grandma lives in is quiet.
Do you know the time where the bank opens?
items.exp: 관계부사 why는 for which로 바꿀 수 있어요. 나머지는 which has(주어가 빠짐), the day when(on which), lives in 삭제(where = in which), the time when이 맞아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The town where I grew up has changed a lot.
This is the restaurant which we often visit.
The hospital where my aunt works are very big.
Friday is the day when we have art class.
That's why I couldn't call you yesterday.
items.exp: 문장의 주어는 The hospital(단수)이므로 본동사는 is여야 해요. 관계부사절 속 동사(works)와 본동사를 구별하세요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: This is the park where I want to visit.
Monday is the day on when the shop is closed.
Show me the way how this machine works.
The house in where they live is old.
I know the reason why he was late for school.
items.exp: visit 뒤 목적어가 빠진 불완전한 절이므로 where가 아니라 which/that, 「전치사+which」는 on which, the way how는 함께 못 쓰고, in where는 in which(또는 where)로 써야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I miss the days when we played together.
(b) This is the room where I study every night.
(c) Busan is the city which I visited last year.
(d) Tell me the reason why you are upset.
(e) The store where sells fresh fruit is closed.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 시간 → when. (b) 옳음: 장소 + 완전한 절 → where. (c) 옳음: visited의 목적어가 빠진 불완전한 절 → 관계대명사 which. (d) 옳음: 이유 → why. (e) 틀림: 주어가 빠진 절이므로 관계대명사 → which sells. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) The library where I often go to is near my house.
(b) This is how she became a famous singer.
(c) Spring is the season when flowers come out.
(d) The place where we camped was beautiful.
(e) The year when I was born were 2012.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: where = to which이므로 to를 또 쓰지 않아요 → where I often go. (b) 옳음: how 단독. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: 주어 The year 단수 → was. 따라서 틀린 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) The day when we arrived was sunny.
(b) This is the house which I was born.
(c) He explained the way how he solved the problem.
(d) The hotel which we stayed at was clean.
(e) I don't know why did he leave.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: 완전한 절이므로 where(= in which) → the house where I was born. (c) 틀림: the way how 불가. (d) 옳음: at의 목적어 which, 전치사가 끝에 남아요. (e) 틀림: 간접의문문 어순 → why he left. 따라서 옳은 것은 2개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) The village where my dad was born is small.
(b) Do you remember the time when the train leaves?
(c) This is the bakery when I buy bread.
(d) The reason why she cried is not clear.
(e) The museum where we visited was crowded.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 장소 → where. (b) 옳음: 시간 → when. (c) 틀림: 장소 선행사 → where. (d) 옳음: 이유 → why. (e) 틀림: visited의 목적어가 빠졌으므로 which/that. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This is the way I fixed the computer.
(b) I visited the town which my dad was born.
(c) The office in which he works is on the fifth floor.
(d) Saturday is the day which I play tennis.
(e) The reason which she gave us was strange.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: the way 단독. (b) 틀림: 완전한 절 → where. (c) 옳음: in which = where. (d) 틀림: 완전한 절 → when(on which). (e) 옳음: gave의 목적어가 빠진 불완전한 절이므로 관계대명사 which가 맞아요. 틀린 것은 (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) This is the place at which the accident happened.
(b) I can't forget the moment which I heard the news.
(c) The hotel where we stayed in had a pool.
(d) Can you show me how you made it?
(e) The reason why he was late were not clear.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: at which = where. (b) 틀림: 완전한 절 → when. (c) 틀림: where = in which이므로 in 삭제. (d) 옳음: how 단독. (e) 틀림: 주어 The reason 단수 → was. 옳은 것은 (a), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) This is the hall ___ the concert will be held.
(B) This is the hall ___ was built ten years ago.
items.exp: (A) 뒤에 완전한 절(수동태)이 오므로 관계부사 where, (B) 주어가 빠진 불완전한 절이므로 주격 관계대명사 which예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I don't know the reason ___ he quit his job.
(B) I remember the day ___ which we moved here.
items.exp: (A) 이유 선행사 the reason → why, (B) when은 「전치사+which」로 바꿀 수 있고, 날(day) 앞의 전치사는 on이에요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 where의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> This is the park [where] we first met.
choices: The shop [where] I bought this hat is closed.
Can you tell me [where] the station is?
items.exp: <보기>의 where는 선행사 the park를 꾸미는 관계부사예요. 'The shop where I bought'만 같고, 나머지는 '어디'라는 의문사예요.

items.q:
밑줄 친 when의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> I remember the night [when] it snowed heavily.
choices: [When] I was young, I lived in Daegu.
Do you know [when] the movie starts?
July is the month [when] summer vacation starts.
items.exp: <보기>의 when은 선행사 the night를 꾸미는 관계부사예요. 'the month when'만 같고, 나머지는 '~할 때'라는 접속사이거나 '언제'라는 의문사예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 이곳은 우리 아버지가 일하시는 공장이다.
items.s: This is the factory ___.
items.exp: 장소 선행사 뒤에 완전한 절이 오므로 관계부사 where를 쓰고, 주어 my father가 단수이므로 works예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그것이 그가 시험에 떨어진 이유이다.
items.s: That is ___ the test.
items.exp: '그것이 ~한 이유이다'는 That is why ~로 써요. 과거의 일이므로 failed예요.

items.q: 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿀 때 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I visited the house. + My favorite writer lived in the house.
items.s: I visited the house ___.
items.exp: in the house(장소의 부사구)를 관계부사 where로 바꾸므로 in을 다시 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: Do you remember the year in which we first met?
items.s: Do you remember the year ___?
items.exp: 「전치사+which」인 in which는 시간 선행사(the year) 뒤에서 관계부사 when으로 바꿀 수 있어요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: This is the beach [which] we swam last summer. → ___
items.exp: 뒤에 완전한 절(we swam last summer)이 오고 장소 선행사이므로 관계대명사 which가 아니라 관계부사 where를 써요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 동사를 문맥에 맞게 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 상이 수여된 날은 비가 왔다.
items.s: The day when the prize ___ was rainy.
items.exp: 상은 '주어지는' 대상이므로 수동태, 과거의 일이고 주어 the prize가 단수이므로 was given이에요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: If I had a car, I would drive you home.
If she had heard the news, she would have called us.
If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go fishing.
If I had wings, I could fly to you.
If we had practiced more, we would win the game last week.
items.exp: last week라는 과거 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거완료를 써야 해요. would win → would have won이에요. If it is sunny tomorrow ~는 실제 가능한 조건문이라 옳아요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: If I knew her number, I will call her.
If you had come to the party, you would have met Jina.
If it didn't rain, we can play outside.
If I have more time, I would learn to swim.
If she studied harder last year, she would have passed.
items.exp: 가정법 과거완료 「If+had p.p., would have p.p.」 형태가 맞아요. 가정법 과거는 「If+과거, would/could+동사원형」이므로 will → would, can → could, have → had로, last year는 과거이므로 had studied로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: As I don't have money, I can't buy the bag. = If I had money, I could buy the bag.
If I were you, I wouldn't say that.
If he had been there, he would have helped me.
If they would have a map, they wouldn't get lost.
If the weather were nice, we would go hiking.
items.exp: 가정법 과거의 if절에는 would를 쓰지 않고 동사의 과거형을 써요. → If they had a map, they wouldn't get lost.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: If I hadn't lost my phone, I could have called you.
If I had not been sick, I would go to the concert yesterday.
If I were you, I will take the bus.
If my brother were here, he will help us.
If I had knew the answer, I would tell you.
items.exp: 가정법 과거완료 「If+had p.p., could have p.p.」가 맞아요. yesterday는 과거라 would have gone, 가정법 과거 주절은 would take/would help, had knew → knew로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) If I lived near the sea, I would swim every day.
(b) If she had asked me, I would have helped her.
(c) If it snows tomorrow, we would make a snowman.
(d) If I were taller, I could reach the shelf.
(e) If you had told me earlier, I would have came.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거. (b) 옳음: 가정법 과거완료. (c) 틀림: 실제 가능한 조건문이므로 will make. (d) 옳음: 가정법 과거 were. (e) 틀림: have 뒤에는 과거분사 → would have come. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) If I had enough time, I would read more books.
(b) If he hadn't eaten so much, he wouldn't have felt sick.
(c) If we had a dog, we would walk it every morning.
(d) If I knew how to cook, I would make dinner for you.
(e) If they had won the game, they would celebrate last night.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: 가정법 과거완료. (c) 옳음. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: last night는 과거 → would have celebrated. 따라서 틀린 것은 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 두 문장의 뜻이 같은 것의 개수는?
(a) If I had a bike, I could ride it. = As I don't have a bike, I can't ride it.
(b) If she had been careful, she wouldn't have fallen. = As she wasn't careful, she fell.
(c) If it weren't cold, we would go out. = As it is cold, we don't go out.
(d) If I had studied, I would have passed. = As I didn't study, I didn't pass.
(e) If he were rich, he would buy a house. = As he was not rich, he didn't buy a house.
items.exp: (a) 같음: 가정법 과거 ↔ 직설법 현재. (b) 같음: 가정법 과거완료 ↔ 직설법 과거. (c) 같음. (d) 같음. (e) 다름: 가정법 과거는 현재 사실의 반대 → As he is not rich, he doesn't buy a house. 따라서 같은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If I were a bird, I would fly over the mountains.
(b) If he had studied harder, he would pass the test last month.
(c) If you mix red and white, you get pink.
(d) If I had a million won, I will buy a new laptop.
(e) If we hadn't taken a taxi, we would have been late.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거. (b) 틀림: last month → would have passed. (c) 옳음: 일반적 사실의 조건문. (d) 틀림: 가정법 과거 → would buy. (e) 옳음: 가정법 과거완료. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If she had a key, she could open the door.
(b) If I had seen you, I would have said hello.
(c) If I am you, I would apologize.
(d) If it hadn't rained, we would have gone on a picnic.
(e) If they had left on time, they would have arrive earlier.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: 가정법 과거의 if절 → If I were you. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: have 뒤에는 과거분사 → would have arrived. 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) If he knew the answer, he would tell us.
(b) If I had gone to bed early, I wouldn't have been so tired.
(c) If we had more players, we can make a team.
(d) If I hadn't forgotten my umbrella, I wouldn't have gotten wet.
(e) If she lives near here, she would visit us often.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: 가정법 과거 주절 → could make. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: 주절이 would이므로 if절은 과거 → If she lived. 옳은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If I ___ your address now, I would send you a card.
(B) If I ___ your address last week, I would have sent you a card.
items.exp: (A) now, 주절 would send → 현재 사실 반대인 가정법 과거 knew, (B) last week, 주절 would have sent → 과거 사실 반대인 가정법 과거완료 had known이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If it ___ so cold, we could play outside.
(B) If you had listened to me, you ___ that mistake.
items.exp: (A) 주절이 could play(가정법 과거)이므로 weren't, (B) if절이 had listened(가정법 과거완료)이므로 wouldn't have made예요.

items.q:
(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) If I ___ more money, I would travel around the world.
(B) If it ___ tomorrow, the game will be canceled.
(C) If he ___ the bus, he wouldn't have been late.
items.exp: (A) 주절 would travel → 가정법 과거 had. (B) 실제 가능한 조건문이라 현재시제 rains. (C) 주절 wouldn't have been → 가정법 과거완료 had caught예요.

items.q:
다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
If I had known about the sale, I would have bought the shoes.
choices: As I know about the sale, I buy the shoes.
As I didn't know about the sale, I didn't buy the shoes.
As I don't know about the sale, I don't buy the shoes.
As I knew about the sale, I bought the shoes.
As I hadn't known about the sale, I would buy the shoes.
items.exp: 가정법 과거완료는 과거 사실의 반대이므로 직설법 과거 부정문으로 바꿔요. 몰랐기 때문에 사지 않았다는 뜻이에요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그가 그 규칙을 알았더라면, 벌금을 내지 않았을 텐데.
items.s: If he had known the rule, he ___ a fine.
items.exp: 과거 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거완료 주절 「would have p.p.」를 쓰고, 부정은 would 뒤에 not을 넣어요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 지금 시간이 더 있다면, 너를 도울 수 있을 텐데.
items.s: If I ___, I could help you.
items.exp: 현재 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거, if절에 동사의 과거형 had를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As it is raining, we can't go to the beach.
items.s: If it ___, we could go to the beach.
items.exp: 직설법 현재(비가 오고 있다)는 가정법 과거로 바꾸면서 긍정은 부정으로 바꿔요. 진행형도 과거로 바뀌어 were not raining이 돼요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: As I didn't wear a coat, I caught a cold.
items.s: If I had worn a coat, I ___ a cold.
items.exp: 직설법 과거(입지 않아서 감기에 걸렸다)는 가정법 과거완료로 바꾸고, 긍정은 부정으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: If she [has] my email address, she would write to me. → ___
items.exp: 주절이 would write(가정법 과거)이므로 if절에도 동사의 과거형 had를 써요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 동사를 문맥에 맞게 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 어젯밤에 창문이 닫혀 있었더라면, 방이 그렇게 춥지 않았을 텐데.
items.s: If the window ___ last night, the room wouldn't have been so cold.
items.exp: 어젯밤(과거) 사실의 반대이므로 가정법 과거완료, 창문은 '닫히는' 대상이므로 수동태 had been closed예요.

units.name: Ch12-2 I wish, as if 가정법

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I wish I could speak Chinese well.
She talks as if she had been to Paris.
I wish I had listened to my mom yesterday.
I wish my sister will lend me her bike.
He acts as if he knew all the answers.
items.exp: I wish 가정법에는 will을 쓰지 않아요. 현재의 이룰 수 없는 소망은 과거형 → I wish my sister would lend(또는 lent) me her bike처럼 써야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: I wish I have a bigger room.
I wish I had went to the concert.
He talks as if he were a famous chef.
I wish I can fly like a bird.
I wish it stops raining soon.
items.exp: as if 가정법 과거 「as if+주어+were」가 맞아요. I wish 뒤에는 과거형(had, could)이나 과거완료(had gone)를 써야 하고, have/can/stops 같은 현재형은 쓰지 않아요.

items.q: 다음 중 두 문장의 뜻이 같지 않은 것은?
choices: I wish I were good at math. = I'm sorry I'm not good at math.
He talks as if he were rich. = In fact, he isn't rich.
I wish I hadn't lied to her. = I'm sorry I lied to her.
She acts as if she had met me. = In fact, she didn't meet me.
I wish I knew his name. = I'm sorry I didn't know his name.
items.exp: I wish+가정법 과거는 현재 사실의 반대예요. → I'm sorry I don't know his name.이 되어야 해요.

items.q: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: I wish you had been here yesterday.
I wish I didn't eat so much last night.
I wish I were not so tired yesterday.
I wish I will win the contest next week.
He acts as if he had be a soldier.
items.exp: yesterday(과거) 사실의 반대이므로 I wish+had p.p.가 맞아요. last night·yesterday도 had p.p.(hadn't eaten, hadn't been), I wish 뒤 will 불가, had be → had been으로 고쳐야 해요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I wish I had a pet dog.
(b) I wish I had studied harder for the test.
(c) He talks as if he were my older brother.
(d) I wish you can come to my party.
(e) She acts as if she hadn't heard anything last night.
items.exp: (a) 옳음: 가정법 과거. (b) 옳음: 가정법 과거완료. (c) 옳음: as if+were. (d) 틀림: I wish 뒤에는 can 불가 → could come. (e) 옳음: 과거 사실 반대 → had p.p. 따라서 옳은 것은 4개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
(a) I wish I were not so busy these days.
(b) I wish I had not broken the vase.
(c) I wish I had knew the answer.
(d) She looks as if she were a model.
(e) I wish I could go back to my childhood.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음. (c) 틀림: had 뒤에는 과거분사 → had known. (d) 옳음: as if+were. (e) 옳음: I wish+could. 따라서 틀린 것은 1개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
(a) I wish I live in a big city.
(b) He acts as if he were the king of the world.
(c) I wish I hadn't missed the bus this morning.
(d) I wish I didn't say that to him yesterday.
(e) She talks as if she had lived in London for years.
items.exp: (a) 틀림: I wish 뒤 현재형 불가 → lived. (b) 옳음. (c) 옳음: 과거 사실 반대. (d) 틀림: yesterday → hadn't said. (e) 옳음: as if+had p.p. 따라서 옳은 것은 3개예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wish I could play the guitar.
(b) I wish I have more free time.
(c) He talks as if he had been there before.
(d) I wish I were taller than my brother.
(e) She acts as if she know everything.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 틀림: → had more free time. (c) 옳음: as if+had p.p. (d) 옳음: I wish+were. (e) 틀림: 주어 she와 know가 맞지 않아요 → 가정법 knew. 옳은 것은 (a), (c), (d)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wish I hadn't spent all my money.
(b) I wish I had gone to bed earlier last night.
(c) I wish my friends will visit me.
(d) He talks as if he were a doctor.
(e) I wish I can swim like a fish.
items.exp: (a) 옳음. (b) 옳음: last night → had gone. (c) 틀림: I wish 뒤 will 불가 → would visit. (d) 옳음. (e) 틀림: can → could. 틀린 것은 (c), (e)예요.

items.q:
다음 중 두 문장의 뜻이 같은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
(a) I wish I had a sister. = I'm sorry I don't have a sister.
(b) I wish I had been there. = I'm sorry I wasn't there.
(c) He talks as if he were sick. = In fact, he was not sick.
(d) She acts as if she had won. = In fact, she didn't win.
(e) I wish I could help you. = I'm sorry I can help you.
items.exp: (a) 같음: 가정법 과거 ↔ 현재 부정. (b) 같음: 가정법 과거완료 ↔ 과거 부정. (c) 다름: as if+were는 현재 사실 반대 → he is not sick. (d) 같음. (e) 다름: 긍정·부정이 반대 → I'm sorry I can't help you. 같은 것은 (a), (b), (d)예요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) I wish I ___ a car now.
(B) I wish I ___ that movie last weekend.
items.exp: (A) now → 현재 사실 반대이므로 가정법 과거 had, (B) last weekend → 과거 사실 반대이므로 가정법 과거완료 had seen이에요.

items.q:
(A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(A) He talks as if he ___ everything. (In fact, he doesn't know everything.)
(B) She looks as if she ___ a ghost. (In fact, she didn't see a ghost.)
items.exp: (A) 현재 사실의 반대이므로 as if+과거 knew, (B) 과거 사실의 반대이므로 as if+과거완료 had seen이에요.

items.q:
다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것은?
I'm sorry that I didn't bring my camera.
choices: I wish I brought my camera.
I wish I didn't bring my camera.
I wish I had brought my camera.
I wish I hadn't brought my camera.
I wish I have brought my camera.
items.exp: 과거에 하지 못한 일의 아쉬움은 I wish+had p.p.로 나타내고, 직설법 부정(didn't bring)은 가정법 긍정(had brought)으로 바뀌어요.

items.q:
다음 사실과 의미가 통하는 문장은?
In fact, he isn't a famous singer.
choices: He talks as if he had been a famous singer.
He talks as if he is not a famous singer.
He talked as if he hadn't been a famous singer.
He talks as if he were a famous singer.
He talks as if he weren't a famous singer.
items.exp: 현재 사실(유명 가수가 아니다)의 반대는 as if+가정법 과거로, 부정을 긍정으로 바꿔 as if he were a famous singer예요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 내가 그 시험에 대해 미리 알았더라면 좋았을 텐데.
items.s: I wish ___ about the test in advance.
items.exp: 과거에 이루지 못한 일의 아쉬움이므로 I wish+had p.p.를 써요.

items.q: 우리말과 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그는 마치 그 사고를 직접 본 것처럼 말한다. (사실은 보지 못했다.)
items.s: He talks as if ___ the accident himself.
items.exp: 과거 사실(보지 못했다)의 반대이므로 as if+had p.p.를 써요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: I'm sorry that I can't go to the concert with you.
items.s: I wish ___ to the concert with you.
items.exp: I'm sorry+직설법 현재 부정(can't)은 I wish+가정법 과거 긍정(could)으로 바꿔요.

items.q: 두 문장의 뜻이 같도록 조건에 맞게 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: She acts as if she were the leader of our team.
items.s: In fact, ___ the leader of our team.
items.exp: as if+가정법 과거(were)는 현재 사실의 반대이므로, 실제로는 현재 부정 she is not이에요.

items.q: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰세요.
items.s: I wish I [didn't waste] so much time last weekend. → ___
items.exp: last weekend는 과거이므로 과거 사실에 대한 아쉬움은 I wish+had p.p. → had not wasted예요.

items.q: 괄호 안의 동사를 문맥에 맞게 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 빈칸을 완성하세요.
items.ctx: 그 아이는 마치 며칠 동안 아무것도 먹지 못한 것처럼 보인다. (사실은 잘 먹었다.)
items.s: The child looks as if he ___ anything for days.
items.exp: 사실(잘 먹었다)과 반대로 '먹지 못했던 것처럼'이므로 as if+과거완료를 쓰고, 부정이므로 had not eaten이에요.
